policies.summary: Government of Canada travel guidance expressly records visa-free tourist entry for these ordinary Canadian-passport destinations, subject to their stated durations.
conditions: BA: tourist stays up to 90 days; registration is required after three or more days. VG: tourist stays up to six months, with an ED card, arrival/departure taxes and requested onward-ticket, funds and accommodation evidence.
TN: tourist stays up to 90 days. UA: tourist stays up to 90 days in 180 days; work is separate and dual-national Ukrainian entry rules may apply. PA: tourist stays up to 180 days.

This records only a Regular Canadian passport short-visitor baseline. It excludes diplomatic, official, emergency and temporary documents, residence, work, study, transit, health, carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Comoros tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance expressly permits a Canadian tourist visa on arrival at Moroni airport and other points of entry.
conditions: Available for tourist travel at Prince Said Ibrahim International Airport in Moroni or other points of entry; the stated fee can be paid in euros.
An onward or return ticket is required. Business, student, residence, special-document and final-admission cases are not normalized.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Iraq electronic visitor-visa route
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance expressly identifies an online Iraqi visa route before travel for Canadian passport holders.
conditions: Canadian passport holders travelling by air via Baghdad may obtain the required federal Iraqi visa online before travel; an embassy or consulate route is also stated.

Kurdistan requires a separate electronic visa and a distinct Iraqi visa is needed to travel beyond it. This does not classify residence, work, study, transit, special documents, registration, security or final admission.

application.label: Iraqi Ministry of Interior electronic visa portal
steps: Confirm whether travel is to federal Iraq or the Kurdistan Region and use the appropriate official electronic route.
Apply online before departure using the Regular Canadian passport to be used for travel.
Comply with any regional registration and final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic visitor-visa route
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance expressly requires an e-visa through the Government of South Sudan website before departure.
conditions: Obtain the e-visa online through the Government of South Sudan website before departure.
This does not classify transit, work, study, residence, special documents, registration, health, security or final-admission requirements.

application.label: Government of South Sudan e-Visa portal
steps: Apply online before departure using the Regular Canadian passport to be used for travel.
Carry the issued travel authorization as required by the portal and carrier.
Comply with destination registration, health, security and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: named advance mission visa routes
policies.summary: Government of Canada guidance describes a pre-departure mission-issued visa route for each listed destination, rather than an electronic or border-issued visa.
conditions: LY: visas are issued only to residents in the application country, after in-person embassy or consulate submission; mail applications are not accepted.

SY: non-Arab nationals cannot obtain a visa at border points and must obtain it from a Syrian embassy or consulate before departure. Israeli and certain Egyptian/Jordanian-border stamps can result in denial.
This does not classify journalist special permission, business, work, study, residence, transit, special documents, operational restrictions or final admission.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: specified visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Smartraveller guidance expressly establishes visa-free visitor access for these destinations.
conditions: XK: tourist stay under 90 days in 180; UA: up to 90 days in 180, but airspace and borders remain operationally constrained; TN: 90 days or less; PA: air or land arrival, initial 90 days; BA: up to 90 days in six months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, health, carrier and final-admission conditions are outside this classification.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: explicitly electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Current Australian guidance or a destination-controlled official service establishes electronic visitor-visa issuance for these ordinary passports.
conditions: IQ: federal Iraq electronic visa is required before travel; Kurdistan has a separate regional route. CU: Cuba's online tourist visa replaces the Tourist Card.
All routes remain subject to passport, purpose, entry-point, security, health and final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: specified tourist visas on arrival
policies.summary: Current guidance expressly makes an arrival-issued tourist visa available to Australian ordinary-passport visitors.
conditions: BD: Bangladesh's mission guidance names Australian nationals for the conditional tourism visa-on-arrival route, normally a maximum 30-day single entry; officer satisfaction and supporting-document requirements apply.
KH: tourist visas on arrival are valid for 30 days; the e-visa is an alternative route, not a reason to classify the visitor baseline as electronic-only.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: expressly pre-departure visas
policies.summary: Smartraveller expressly requires these visas before arrival or travel.
conditions: TM also requires a letter of invitation, even for transit. TD and NE require a visa before arrival/travel.
This does not normalize work, residence, special documents, entry-point, security or final-admission requirements.

policies.title: New Zealand ordinary passports: Kosovo visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Kosovo's official inbound visa guidance includes New Zealand among nationalities that do not need a short-stay visa.
conditions: Kosovo Interior Ministry guidance states a foreigner's short stay may be up to 90 days in each 180-day period, subject to ordinary admission conditions.
This does not classify work, residence, transit, special documents, means, address registration, health, security or final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: specified visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Irish DFA entry guidance expressly records visa-free ordinary Irish-passport access for the listed destinations.
conditions: VG: no visa is required. CU: no visa is required, but a tourist card and a D’Viajeros arrival form are required; the card is not normalized as a visa.
XK: visit visa-free for up to 90 days. UA: visa-free stays up to 90 days; martial-law, border accessibility, security, dual-nationality and final-admission rules remain separate.
PA: visa-free for up to 90 days. BA: visa-free short visits up to 90 days. TN: no visa is required; the DFA page does not state a duration.
This records visitor baselines only, not work, residence, study, transit, special documents, carrier rules or final admission.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: expressly available visitor visas on arrival
policies.summary: Current Irish DFA guidance expressly describes a border-issued visitor visa route for each listed destination.
conditions: DJ: a tourist visa may be purchased on arrival for cash in USD. KM: a visa is available at Hahaya airport or other points of entry for the stated fee.
KH: a tourist visa is available at the Cambodian border; two passport photographs and USD payment are stated, and the tourist visa is stated as one month with one possible one-month extension.

Cambodia also offers a tourist e-Visa, but the expressly available arrival-issued route is the status recorded for this pair. Final-admission, entry-point, purpose, document and health conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: expressly electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Current Irish DFA guidance expressly states an electronic visa route for the listed destinations.
conditions: IQ: the DFA states that visas can be obtained online via the Republic of Iraq Ministry of the Interior website. Federal-Iraq and Kurdistan-region rules, entry points, security, purpose and final admission remain separate.
GQ: the DFA expressly says Irish citizens can apply online for an electronic visa. Passport validity, health, purpose, entry-point and final-admission rules remain applicable.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: expressly pre-departure mission visas
policies.summary: DFA guidance establishes an advance mission-application or pre-flight possession requirement for these ordinary Irish-passport visitor routes.
conditions: GW: applications are made in person at Guinea-Bissau diplomatic missions in Paris or Lisbon. LR: applications from Ireland are submitted to the Liberian Embassy in London.

SS: the DFA says a visitor cannot fly to Juba without a valid visa, establishing that the visa must be held before departure; the page does not normalize any online filing channel as electronic issuance.
Visitor purpose, document, sponsor, registration, health, security and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: The Federal Foreign Office expressly records visa-free short-visitor entry for the listed German ordinary-passport destinations.
conditions: VG: tourism up to 90 days, with an online entry and customs form before departure. XK: entry and stays up to 90 days. UA: up to 90 days in each 180-day period. TN: tourism, private or business stays up to 120 days. PA: up to 90 days. BA: up to 90 days in six months.
This records an ordinary German passport short-visitor baseline only; it excludes work, residence, study, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: The Federal Foreign Office expressly identifies a border-issued short-visitor route for each listed German ordinary-passport destination.
conditions: DJ: a visa can be applied for at entry. KM: tourist visa is issued on arrival at Grande Comore international airport. TM: airport issuance requires a pre-issued Turkmen Migration Service visa approval/invitation. CI: prior online application is followed by issuance at entry. GW: airport visa is available for 30 days; land-border issuance is unavailable. BD: normally available for tourism or business up to 30 days at Dhaka international airport, subject to listed documents. KH: tourist visa is available on arrival at all international border crossings.

TM and CI are classified as visa_on_arrival because the visa itself is issued at the border after pre-approval, not because of their online or pre-travel steps. This excludes special documents, work, residence and final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: named electronic visitor-visa routes
policies.summary: Official guidance identifies an electronic visa issued before travel for the listed German ordinary-passport visitor routes.
conditions: IQ: federal Iraq ended visa-on-arrival issuance on 1 March 2025 and requires an e-visa before entry; Kurdistan has a distinct e-visa process. CU: the Cuban official tourism portal describes the internet tourist visa replacing the tourist card. GQ: for air entry, an online e-visa is required; land entry requires mission processing. NG: since May 2025 only electronic visas are used, delivered with a QR code by email. TD: the entry visa must be applied for online at least seven days before travel.
This excludes separate non-tourist visa categories, route-specific limits, health forms, registration and final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: named advance visa routes
policies.summary: The Federal Foreign Office expressly requires pre-departure mission issuance for each listed German ordinary-passport visitor route.
conditions: KP: entry is limited to organized travel with assigned guides or interpreters and Foreign Ministry permission; tourist cases are handled by the travel agency, require a Korean-side invitation, and embassy issuance normally takes at least four weeks. LY: apply at the Libyan Embassy in Berlin for a Germany-based applicant. CG: apply before entry at the Republic of the Congo Embassy in Berlin. SS: apply before entry at the South Sudan Embassy in Berlin. CF: apply before entry at the competent Central African Embassy in Paris. LR: visa-on-arrival issuance has ended; Germany-based travellers apply at the Liberian Embassy in Berlin. ML: apply at a Malian foreign mission in Germany.
This does not normalize travel warnings, operational access, invitations, special documents, work, residence, transit or final admission.

policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Singapore MFA destination guidance expressly records visa-free ordinary Singapore-passport visitor access for these destinations.
conditions: BA: up to 90 days within six months and no employment; KH: tourists up to 30 days; TN: up to 90 days; PA: up to 90 days; CU: up to 30 days; XK: visit or transit up to 90 days within six months.

KH e-Arrival is an immigration, health and customs declaration, not an ETA or visa. PA, CU and all other entries remain subject to passport, health, funds, onward-travel, security, carrier and final-admission conditions.
This is an ordinary Singapore-passport short-visitor baseline and excludes work, residence, extensions, special documents and individual admissibility.

policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: Ukraine electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Singapore MFA says Singaporeans can obtain Ukraine's electronic visa for ordinary short-visitor purposes.
conditions: The stated eVisa is valid for 30 days and can be single or double entry for tourism and other stated visitor purposes.

Singapore MFA also records a separate conditional visa-on-arrival route at Boryspil and Odesa airports. This policy records the expressly electronic route, not airport accessibility, martial-law, insurance, entry-point, work, residence, special-document or final-admission treatment.

application.label: Ukraine Ministry of Foreign Affairs eVisa web platform
steps: Use the official Ukraine MFA eVisa web platform before travel.
Apply with the ordinary Singapore passport intended for travel and retain the issued electronic visa.
Confirm current Ukrainian insurance, border-access and final-admission conditions before departure.

policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: Bangladesh visa on arrival
policies.summary: Singapore MFA states that Bangladesh visa-on-arrival facilities are available to Singaporeans.
conditions: Singapore MFA warns that the facility can change at short notice and advises applying before arrival where practical.

This records the stated arrival-issuance facility only. It does not classify online application followed by paper submission at the Bangladesh High Commission as an eVisa, or work, business support, special documents, health, carrier or final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: specified visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Japan MOFA guidance expressly records visa-free short-visitor access for the listed Japanese ordinary-passport destinations.
conditions: TN: tourism, business or visiting-acquaintance stays up to three months. PA: tourism up to 90 days, with passport, onward transport and funds requirements.
BA: aggregate stays up to 90 days in six months. XK: visa-exempt; a special permit is required after 90 days. This does not classify work, residence, special documents or final admission.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Cuba electronic visa
policies.summary: Japan MOFA says Cuba's electronic visa is the only valid entry instrument and links the official application service.
conditions: Apply through Cuba's official eVisa service before travel. Purpose, passport, health, entry-form and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: expressly available arrival-issued visitor visas
policies.summary: Japan MOFA expressly describes border issuance for the listed Japanese ordinary-passport routes.
conditions: KM: arrival-airport issuance is available to direct arrivals from Japan and other countries without a Comoros overseas mission.
CI: online application and payment yield an authorization; the visa itself is obtained at Abidjan airport, so it is classified as visa on arrival rather than eVisa.
KH: visas are available on arrival at major airports and land borders. Cambodia also provides an eVisa route, but the expressly stated arrival route is the status recorded.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: specified advance visitor visas
policies.summary: Japan MOFA expressly requires the listed visas to be obtained before entry or arrival.
conditions: DJ: obtain the purpose-appropriate visa before entry through an embassy or the named online application site; online application does not by itself prove electronic issuance.
GW: a visa is required regardless of entry purpose and must be obtained before arrival; yellow-fever and final-admission requirements remain applicable.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: Official guidance expressly records visa-free short-visitor access for these French ordinary-passport destinations.
conditions: VG: France is absent from the BVI Government’s current list of visa-required nationalities. XK: 90 days in six months. UA: 90 days in 180 days. TN: up to three months. PA: tourist stays under 90 days. BA: stays up to 90 days.
This is the ordinary French-passport visitor baseline only; it excludes work, residence, special documents, carrier rules and final admission.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Official guidance identifies a border-issued visitor visa route for each listed French ordinary-passport destination.
conditions: DJ: a one-month visa can be obtained at entry, though France Diplomatie also lists a short-stay e-visa route. KM: visa at Moroni airport. TM: airport or port issuance requires the national migration service invitation. GA: obtain the DGDI travel-authorisation receipt before flying to Libreville Léon-Mba airport; the visa sticker and payment occur on arrival. CI: online registration and payment precede visa issuance at Abidjan airport. BD: eligible travellers apply online before departure and receive the visa at arrival for up to 30 days. KH: tourist visas are available directly at all international air, land, sea and river borders.
GA, TM, CI and BD are visa_on_arrival because the visa itself is issued at the border after an online or pre-authorisation step. This excludes final admission and route-specific exclusions.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named electronic visitor-visa routes
policies.summary: Current French Government guidance identifies an electronic visitor visa issued before travel for the listed routes.
conditions: IQ: federal Iraq ended tourist visa-on-arrival issuance on 1 March 2025; use eservice.evisa.iq before departure. CU: the tourist visa is mandatory and applied for online through evisacuba.cu, with a confirmation code sent by email.
This excludes Iraq’s distinct Kurdistan route, non-tourist categories, carrier requirements and final admission.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named advance visa routes
policies.summary: Current official material establishes advance mission processing or issuance for each listed French ordinary-passport visitor route.
conditions: AF: single-entry visas are issued by Afghanistan’s Embassy in France. KP: visa available through the DPRK General Delegation in France. LY: visa before arrival. SD: prior visa. SY: Syrian diplomatic or consular representation issues the visa. CG: obtain before departure; no arrival visa. SS: airlines may refuse boarding without a pre-departure visa and France-based applicants use the Paris embassy. CF: the CAR Paris Embassy processes the passport and short-stay application. GQ: no arrival visa and the Paris embassy states required documents. GW: French applications go to the Guinea-Bissau Embassy in Paris; its exceptional Bissau-airport route is not the standard France-resident route. LR: France residents apply through the Liberian Embassy. ML: Mali consulates in Paris or Lyon issue it; no arrival visa. NE: prior visa only; no arrival visa. NG: portal submission is followed by physical dossier submission to OIS Paris for processing. TD: diplomatic or consular mission issuance only; no border visa.
This records ordinary French-passport short-visitor routes only and does not normalize travel warnings, operational access, work, residence, special documents or final admission.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: Current destination-government material expressly establishes visa-free ordinary Swiss-passport visitor access for the listed destinations.
conditions: BA: the current Ministry of Security visitor information includes the Swiss Confederation in the visa-free nationality set. UA: up to 90 days in 180 days for private or tourist purposes; wartime border access remains separate.
This is a narrow ordinary-passport visitor baseline and does not classify work, residence, study, special documents, document validity, security restrictions, carrier conditions or final admission.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's official Tourism Ministry portal identifies an internet tourist-visa process that replaces the Tourist Card and is available worldwide, including Switzerland.
conditions: The portal describes an internet tourist visa replacing the Tourist Card and states worldwide availability except for a United States-specific purchase arrangement.

Tourist visas are single-entry and normally allow up to 90 days, extendable for a further 90 days. Cuban citizens/residents, work, residence, transit, health declarations, route-specific carrier requirements and final admission are outside this classification.

application.label: Cuba electronic tourist-visa service
steps: Apply for the tourist visa online before departure using the Swiss ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Follow the official service's instructions for the visa code and any required travel declaration.
Meet all passport, insurance, return-ticket and final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The Dutch Foreign Ministry expressly records visa-free ordinary Dutch-passport access for the listed short visits.
conditions: VG, UA, TN, PA and BA: visa-free for stays of up to 90 days. XK: the guidance says no visa is required but does not state a stay limit.
This records ordinary-passport visitor baselines only, excluding work, residence, study, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: expressly available visitor visas on arrival
policies.summary: Current Dutch Foreign Ministry guidance expressly describes a border-issued visitor-visa route for each listed destination.
conditions: TM: border-checkpoint issuance requires a prior Invitation Letter from the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan; tourists obtain that invitation through a Turkmen travel agency. Document, entry-point and final-admission conditions remain applicable.
KH: Dutch guidance expressly allows a tourist visa to be requested on arrival; Cambodia also offers a government online route, but the available border-issued route is recorded here.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: expressly electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Official Dutch guidance explicitly identifies an electronic visa route for the listed ordinary Dutch-passport visitors.
conditions: LY: the official Libyan eVisa introduced in July 2026 is stated as valid for 30 days. IQ and CU: Dutch guidance directs ordinary Dutch-passport holders to named government eVisa systems. NG: the guidance expressly identifies Nigeria Immigration Service's eVisa route as an alternative to embassy processing.

IQ Kurdistan-region procedures and Erbil airport issuance are distinct from the federal-Iraq eVisa baseline. Route-specific purpose, passport, preapproval, document, health, carrier and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: expressly pre-departure mission visas
policies.summary: Official Dutch guidance establishes a mission application/issuance route before travel for the listed ordinary Dutch-passport visitor cases.
conditions: AF: apply at Afghanistan's embassy in The Hague. LR: apply at Liberia's embassy in Brussels. TD: apply at Chad's embassy in Brussels.

BD: the Dutch guidance points to the official portal and Bangladesh Embassy in The Hague; Bangladesh's government portal requires an online form to be printed and taken with documents and fees to a Bangladesh mission or visa office, so the online form is not itself an eVisa.
This excludes work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: South Sudan ordinary passports: Cuban electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current Foreign Ministry electronic tourist-visa service directly accepts South Sudan nationality and issues the electronic visa before travel.
conditions: Use the Cuban Foreign Ministry electronic tourist-visa application with the South Sudan ordinary passport to be used for travel. The issued electronic visa is linked to that passport and the portal sends its code by email.
The portal directs sea travellers to a consular office. Work, residence, study, transit, special documents, carrier rules and final admission are outside this short-visitor policy.

application.label: Cuban Foreign Ministry electronic tourist-visa application
application.processingTime: The portal states that a response is sent within 72 business hours.
steps: Select South Sudan nationality and enter the valid ordinary passport details in the official electronic application.
Complete the specified procedure and receive the electronic-visa code by email before travel.
Travel with the passport to which the electronic visa is linked and comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Taiwan MOFA BOCA's current outbound schedule places these destinations in its visa-free category for Taiwanese travellers.
conditions: This is the ordinary Taiwanese-passport short-visitor baseline recorded in BOCA's current visa-free schedule; destination rules, stay limits and entry conditions can change.
It excludes work, residence, transit-only facilities, emergency or other non-ordinary travel documents, carrier controls and individual final-admission decisions.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: named visa-on-arrival short visits
policies.summary: Taiwan MOFA BOCA's current outbound schedule identifies these destinations as issuing visas at arrival to Taiwanese travellers, including stated pre-clearance routes.
conditions: BY, IR and UZ require the schedule's stated pre-clearance before a visa is issued on arrival; online pre-clearance followed by border issuance is normalized as visa_on_arrival.
CI requires online registration, fee payment and an emailed approval code before the visa is issued at Abidjan airport; it is therefore arrival issuance, not an eVisa under this taxonomy.

LR: apply online, then present the approval QR code at Roberts International Airport for biometric collection and the visa sticker. The Liberia Immigration Service directs applicants in a country with a Liberian embassy to that mission instead.
This does not establish work, residence, non-visitor, transit-only, special-document, carrier, health, funds or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: named electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Taiwan MOFA BOCA's current outbound schedule identifies these destinations' electronic-visa routes for Taiwanese passport holders; Ecuador separately confirms pre-departure electronic issuance.
conditions: EC requires Taiwanese travellers to complete the online electronic-visa application before travel after Ecuador ended the previous visa-free treatment.

SY and TR are listed by BOCA for ordinary ROC passports with the stated visitor-purpose electronic-visa routes; each destination's current duration, purpose, documentation and border rules remain controlling.
This records electronic issuance, not merely online filing. It excludes work, residence, transit-only facilities, special documents, carrier checks and final-admission decisions.

policies.title: Spanish ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: Official current guidance establishes visa-free short-visitor access for each listed Spanish ordinary-passport route.
conditions: VG: Spain is absent from the BVI Government's current list of visa-required nationalities. UA: EU citizens, including Spanish tourists, may stay up to three months without a visa. TN: Spanish citizens are visa-exempt for stays under 90 days.
This is the ordinary Spanish-passport short-visitor baseline only; it excludes work, residence, carrier rules, operational access and final admission.

policies.title: Spanish ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Official current guidance identifies a visitor visa issued at the border for each listed Spanish ordinary-passport destination.
conditions: DJ: the international-airport route is discretionary and MAEC also records a short-stay e-visa route. IQ: Baghdad International Airport issuance follows online application; the online filing does not itself establish an e-visa. KM: airport issuance. TM: Ashgabat airport issuance is limited to a ten-day visa and requires the Turkmen migration-authorised invitation.
This records the expressly stated border-issuance route only; purpose, document, carrier, route and final-admission conditions continue to apply.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA destination guidance expressly records visa-free short visits for these Italian travellers.
conditions: XK, BA, PA and TN: visitor stays up to 90 days under the stated Italian MFA destination guidance.

BA requires a travel document valid at least three months beyond the planned stay; TN requires a passport from 1 January 2025. This excludes work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance states Cuba exclusively issues electronic visas and requires the visa before an Italian traveller departs.
conditions: The electronic visa is required before departure. A tour operator, the EVISA platform, Cuban consular offices or authorised agencies can arrange it.
The D'VIAJEROS form is separate from the visa. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic visa platform
steps: Arrange the electronic visitor visa before departure using the ordinary Italian passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'VIAJEROS arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: federal Iraq electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance requires ordinary EU passports, including Italian ordinary passports, to obtain the federal-Iraq visitor visa exclusively through its designated portal.
conditions: This covers federal Iraq, excluding the Kurdistan Region. Since 2 March 2025, ordinary passport holders of EU countries obtain the visa exclusively through the designated portal, not at an airport.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Federal Iraq electronic visa portal
steps: For federal Iraq, submit the ordinary Italian passport visitor application through the designated portal before travel.
Do not rely on an airport visa-on-arrival route.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA destination guidance expressly identifies these border-issued visitor visa routes for Italian ordinary passports.
conditions: KM: apply directly at arrival in the airport and collect the visa from local immigration offices; approximately EUR30 for one month. KH: short tourist visas can be obtained on arrival at international airports; an optional pre-departure online route also exists.

CI: before departure, obtain the D.S.T.-approved e-mail authorisation and carry the approved pre-registration, passport, yellow-fever certificate and payment receipt; biometric registration and visa printing/issuance occur at Abidjan airport. TM: a local tourist agency invitation and State Migration Service entry authorisation must be positively completed before a visa is issued at the airport or border. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Republic of Korea ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Korea MOFA destination guidance expressly gives these ordinary Korean-passport visitor exemptions.
conditions: BA, XK, PA and TN: up to 90 days on the respective Korea MOFA destination page.
This is an ordinary Republic of Korea passport short-visitor baseline only; work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Republic of Korea ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Korea MOFA destination guidance expressly identifies border-issued ordinary Korean-passport visitor visas.
conditions: KM: a 45-day visa is issued on arrival on production of a valid passport, return ticket and accommodation evidence. KH: ordinary passport holders can obtain a tourist visa at airport and land borders for one month.

policies.summary: For these named ordinary-passport catalog codes, Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism eVisa workflow and a paid, unambiguous Appendix I single-entry fee row establish eligibility and electronic issuance before travel.
conditions: Each listed code was reconciled to an Appendix I country row carrying a nonzero single-entry fee. F5A is a tourism-only, single-entry route. Diplomatic, official, service, temporary, refugee, stateless, residence, work, carrier and final-admission treatment are outside this ordinary-passport visitor policy.

Apply online, upload the required documents and pay the stated visa fee.
Receive the visa certificate by email before departure and present it for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Named nationalities: Bosnia and Herzegovina general citizen visa exemption
policies.summary: Current state-agency guidance expressly lists these nationalities under its general citizen visa-exemption schedule, rather than its separate ordinary-passport-agreement, diplomatic/official, or business-passport sections.
conditions: The cited schedule is a general citizenship exemption. This normalized ordinary-passport row is limited to a passport presented by a citizen of the named state; it does not transfer the exemption to a diplomatic, official, service, business, identity-card, seaman, emergency, refugee, alien or other special travel document.

The general statutory visa-free ceiling is up to 90 days in a six-month period from first entry, unless an applicable treaty or Council of Ministers decision provides otherwise. This grouped current schedule does not establish a different uniform duration for every nationality.
Work, residence, transit, admissibility, passport validity, carrier and final-border-control requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Malaysia ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free agreement route
policies.summary: Current state-agency guidance explicitly places valid Malaysian ordinary passports in its concluded-agreements visa-free section.
conditions: This route is expressly limited to a valid ordinary Malaysian passport under a concluded agreement; it does not establish treatment for diplomatic, official, service, business, identity-card, seaman, emergency, refugee, alien or other special travel documents.
The general statutory visa-free ceiling is up to 90 days in a six-month period from first entry unless the applicable agreement or a Council of Ministers decision provides otherwise.
Work, residence, transit, admissibility, passport validity, carrier and final-border-control requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Brazil ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free entry with annual cap
policies.summary: The live Brazilian Presidency decree promulgates the bilateral agreement: nationals holding valid national passports are visa-exempt for tourism, holidays or business for up to 90 days, capped at 180 days annually from first entry.
conditions: The agreement covers nationals of either party who hold valid national passports. This normalized row is limited to a Brazilian ordinary/national passport and does not extend the route to a diplomatic, official, service, business, identity-card, seaman, emergency, refugee, alien or other special travel document.
A stay may not exceed 90 days and the total length of stay may not exceed 180 days per year from first entry.

The treaty is stated to be valid indefinitely but permits diplomatic suspension or denunciation. The cited live legal record does not itself establish that no later diplomatic notification has occurred; final admission remains with Bosnia and Herzegovina authorities.
Work, residence, transit, admissibility, passport validity, carrier and final-border-control requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Residual foreign ordinary passports: mandatory Saint Kitts and Nevis electronic travel authorisation
policies.summary: The current Government release makes approved electronic travel authorisation mandatory before departure for every visitor from 26 May 2025; all 165 exact residual foreign ordinary-passport pairs are within that rule and outside its stated no-application exceptions.
conditions: The Government release says every visitor must have an approved eTA before departing and says only Saint Kitts and Nevis citizens/residents and OECS citizens do not need to apply. Those passport codes are outside this exact residual cohort; this finding concerns ordinary foreign passports, not diplomatic, official, resident, crew, work, transit, or other special-document routes.

The traveller completes the online eTA process with travel details and documents and receives the approval electronically before travel. This is a pre-travel authorisation, not an arrival form: the release separately retains the electronic Immigration and Customs declaration.

The release labels CARICOM and other categories as service-charge exemptions, not eTA-application exemptions. A fee waiver therefore does not alter the mandatory eTA classification for a residual ordinary passport.

The Nevis Island Administration retains a generic online visa route for travellers who require a visa, but does not publish a current nationality schedule and does not narrow the later every-visitor eTA requirement. The eTA classification records the proven universal, mandatory pre-travel authorisation; it does not assert that a separately required visa can never also apply.
All listed codes are the queue's exact 165 pairs after self, citizenship, OECS, canonical, and easier-route exclusions. No code is duplicated or omitted.

application.label: Saint Kitts and Nevis official eTA portal
application.processingTime: The Government release does not publish a processing time; submit before travel, up to 90 days in advance.
steps: Use the official electronic travel authorisation portal before travelling.
Provide the required travel details and supporting documents.
Receive electronic eTA approval before departure and present it when travelling.

policies.title: Liberian ordinary passport: citizenship entry
policies.summary: The Constitution gives every Liberian citizen the right to enter Liberia at any time.
conditions: Applies only to a traveller whose ordinary passport establishes Liberian citizenship. It is a citizenship classification, not a visa waiver for foreign nationals or special documents. Border inspection and admission controls remain separate.

policies.title: Moroccan, Mauritian and South African ordinary passports: visa-free Gabon entry
policies.summary: The authenticated live DGDI exemption dataset explicitly lists Morocco, Mauritius and South Africa for ordinary, diplomatic and service passports. These are the three exact ordinary-passport exemption codes in this residual cohort.
conditions: The DGDI exemption table expressly gives each of Morocco, Mauritius and South Africa the passport types 'Ordinary Passport, Diplomatic Passport, Service Passport'. This policy is confined to ordinary passport holders and does not derive a waiver from reciprocal treatment or a diplomatic/service-only agreement.
The service describes bilateral-agreement exemptions. Applicable admissibility, passport-validity, health, border, purpose, residence, work, transit, crew, and special-document rules remain separate.
CEMAC ordinary-passport exemptions and Gabon citizenship are outside this exact residual queue and are not duplicated here.

policies.title: Other verified residual ordinary passports: electronic preapproval followed by Gabon arrival visa sticker
policies.summary: For the other 182 verified residual ordinary-passport codes, the authenticated DGDI service requires online travel authorisation before flying but issues and takes payment for the visa sticker on arrival. The normalized route is visa on arrival, not a pre-travel electronically issued visa.
conditions: The live DGDI catalog provides a normal selectable country record for each of these 182 passport nationalities and its exemption table lists none as an ordinary-passport exemption. The portal directs non-exempt applicants through its online visa process and requires a Travel Authorization Receipt before travel.

This is not a genuine pre-travel eVisa issuance: the service says payment occurs on arrival when the eVisa sticker is delivered. The online authorisation is a prerequisite to the border-issued visa, so the normalized status is visa_on_arrival.

The Government's current notice limits this route to air travel through Libreville Léon-Mba International Airport. It does not establish a land, sea, work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, or special-document route.

The DGDI host currently omits a trusted TLS issuer chain. The Government notice directly authenticates the host and the leaf certificate covers it, but the service must be rechecked when its normal secure chain is restored; do not rely on a browser certificate override as independent verification.

application.label: Gabon DGDI electronic travel-authorisation service
application.processingTime: The DGDI service states 72 hours after receipt of the ETA request.
steps: Use the DGDI online service before flying to Libreville.
Complete the form and upload the passport data page and required documents.
Receive the Travel Authorization Receipt before departure.
At Libreville airport, complete payment and receive the physical visa sticker on arrival.

policies.title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines residual ordinary passports: visitor visa-free entry
policies.summary: The dated National Security notice exhaustively names twelve nationalities requiring entry visas. All 159 residual ordinary passports are outside that list, and Passport and Immigration grants an arrival entry permit to other international countries.
conditions: Applies to the listed residual ordinary-passport nationalities for a short visitor stay. The sources do not distinguish special passport classes, so this records only the catalog ordinary-passport baseline. The 12 nationalities expressly requiring entry visas are outside this batch.

Passport and Immigration says entry permits are granted on arrival; its 'Other International Countries' line states three months. Foreign Affairs instead says a majority of foreign nationals receive one month, so no uniform stay duration is normalized.

The dated National Security notice is the controlling nationality rule: it presents the twelve countries for which a visa is required and gives an effective date. The undated central visitor and National Security application pages retain a shorter ten-country list, while Foreign Affairs says thirteen but displays ten; none names a residual passport as visa-required.

An entry permit is not normalized as a visa on arrival. Passport and Immigration describes the arrival document as a permit, while Foreign Affairs separately calls ordinary visitor treatment visa-free.

Work, residence, extension, CSME, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, stateless and other special-document treatment, final admission, health, funds and security requirements remain outside this baseline.

conditions: The live DGDI catalogue contains country records for Germany, the Netherlands and ‘United Kingdom British Citizen’, plus a distinct Ordinary Passport document type; it does not list ordinary passports for those records among the named exemptions.
A Travel Authorization Receipt is required before departure, but payment and physical visa-sticker delivery occur on arrival; this is not a pre-travel electronically issued visa.

The current Government notice limits the route to air travel through Libreville Léon-Mba International Airport. Work, residence, transit, crew, special documents and final admission remain outside this baseline.
The DGDI server currently omits a trusted TLS issuer chain. The central Government directly authenticates the service, but the rule must be refreshed when the normal chain is restored.

application.label: Gabon DGDI electronic travel-authorisation service
application.processingTime: The DGDI service states 72 hours after receipt of the request.
steps: Use the DGDI service before flying to Libreville.
Complete the form and upload the passport data page and required documents.
Receive the Travel Authorization Receipt before departure.
At Libreville airport, complete payment and receive the physical visa sticker on arrival.

policies.title: French West Indies aggregate: shared ordinary-passport visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current Guadeloupe/Martinique and Saint-Martin/Saint-Barthélemy Annex II schedules each waive a short-stay visa for these ordinary passports; the aggregate result is visa-free only where all four constituent territories have the same nationality baseline.
conditions: For this upstream aggregate, French West Indies means Guadeloupe, Martinique, Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy. The two governing orders are separate; this policy retains only ordinary-passport waivers common to both territorial schedules.

The ordinary visitor waiver is for no more than 90 days in any 180-day period unless the row states a narrower limit. Dominica and Saint Lucia are limited in every constituent territory to stays of no more than 15 days and 120 cumulative days in 12 months.

Brazil is visa-free for Guadeloupe and Martinique and separately for Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy; the French-Guiana exception does not alter this aggregate. Australia, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Singapore, the United States and Venezuela retain the schedules' paid-activity/work-authorisation exception.

This is a nationality-and-ordinary-passport visitor baseline only. It does not establish work, residence, paid activity, transit, cruise, biometric/document-specific, diplomatic, official/service, special-document or final-admission treatment. A Schengen visa alone is not sufficient for these territories.

policies.title: French West Indies aggregate: other ordinary passports require an advance overseas-territory visa
policies.summary: For the remaining cleanly modelled ordinary-passport codes, neither current territorial Annex II gives an unconditional nationality waiver across Guadeloupe, Martinique, Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy. An overseas-territory visa is required through the normal pre-travel route; a narrowly discretionary border visa does not create a nationality entitlement.
conditions: The result is the ordinary visitor baseline across all four constituent territories, not a Schengen classification. The normal visa route is territory-specific and pre-travel; a narrowly exceptional, discretionary border visa does not alter this baseline. A Schengen short-stay visa alone does not authorize entry.

Bahrain, Belarus, China, India, Indonesia, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa and Thailand may have a separate waiver when the traveller holds the specified valid French-consular multiple-entry visa (six months to five years). That third-document condition does not change this ordinary-passport baseline.

Valid French/Schengen residence or long-stay documents, cruise/transit treatment, diplomatic and service passports, and other individual exceptions remain conditional and are not normalized into this policy.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current SMF waiver notice names Switzerland among the nationalities that may enter São Tomé and Príncipe without a visa for up to 15 days.
conditions: The live SMF notice names Swiss citizens and sets a maximum 15-day stay, a passport valid for at least three months on entry, funds, and return/onward evidence. Law No. 5/2008 supplies the ordinary-passport entry baseline; the notice does not separately describe Swiss special passports.
This is an ordinary short-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not establish work, residence, business, transit, crew, diplomatic, official or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: South African ordinary passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current SMF waiver notice states that South African ordinary-passport holders are visa-exempt for stays of up to 90 days.
conditions: The notice expressly limits this 90-day agreement entry to ordinary passports; it says separate diplomatic/service agreements were approved in November 2024.
The result is a visitor nationality baseline only and remains subject to passport validity, funds, return/onward evidence, border checks and final admission.

policies.title: Invitation-only ordinary passports: advance visitor visa at an Armenian mission or consular post
policies.summary: The current MFA schedule expressly places every listed passport nationality in an invitation-only visitor-visa route at Armenian diplomatic representations or consular posts abroad.
conditions: This is an ordinary short-visitor passport classification. The MFA schedule applies to the citizens and holders of travel documents of these countries; it requires an invitation and application only at Armenian diplomatic representations or consular posts abroad.

The current official legal procedure reserves electronic entry visas for nationals outside the invitation-only list. This cohort is therefore advance mission/consular visa required, not eVisa or visa on arrival.

A qualifying foreign residence permit creates a separate conditional temporary exemption through 1 July 2027; it does not replace this ordinary-passport baseline. Diplomatic, official, service, work, residence, transit, asylum, and final-admission routes remain separate.

policies.title: Non-exempt ordinary passports: advance visitor visa
policies.summary: None of these ordinary-passport nationalities appears in the current Visa Exemption Order 2023 schedule. Kiribati Immigration expressly requires non-exempt visitors to apply in advance.
conditions: The Order applies its named nationality waiver to ordinary/normal, official/service, and diplomatic ICAO-compliant passports or travel documents. None of this residual ordinary-passport cohort is named, so no listed-document waiver is carried into this baseline; it does not establish special-document treatment.
The current Immigration page requires a passport valid at least six months beyond departure, confirmed onward or return travel, and evidence of sufficient funds.

Visitor-visa processing is an advance route: download the Visitor Visa Application Form, email it with scanned documents to visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki, then follow the visa officer's payment instructions. It is not an eVisa or an unrestricted visa on arrival.

application.label: Kiribati Visitor Visa application instructions
steps: Download the official Visitor Visa Application Form from the Immigration Division resources.
Email the completed form and scanned supporting documents to visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki.
Follow the visa officer's instructions for secure electronic payment before travel.

policies.title: Non-VOA ordinary tourist passports: paper advance visitor visa
policies.summary: The live ICA Visitor Visa page directs a traveller outside the current VOA eligibility list to the paper entry-permit form, and the current FAQ requires that visa to be issued before travel. None of these ordinary-passport codes is in the live VOA list or a directly applicable current Easy Visitor Permit table.
conditions: This ordinary tourist baseline covers holiday, sightseeing, social or recreational visits, and visits to relatives or friends. It does not establish work, business, study, residence, transit, crew, APEC, diplomatic, official, service, special-passport, travel-document, territorial, group-tour, citizenship, or final-admission treatment.

The live VOA schedule's China entry is limited to diplomatic, official and service passports. The 2025 handbook separately limits Chinese ordinary-passport VOA to registered organized tour groups; neither is transferred to the ordinary independent-tourist China row.

The current Visitor Visa page offers electronic lodging to passports eligible for VOA and directs non-VOA applicants to its paper form; the current FAQ independently requires a non-eligible traveller to be issued a visa before travel. This is an advance visa, not VOA, ETA, or an eVisa inference from portal existence.

ICA's linked 2025 handbook says visitor-class applications must be submitted online, while the newer live Visitor Visa page says non-VOA applicants should use the paper form. The handbook and portal demonstrate an operational-route conflict, but neither supplies a current electronic eligibility route for this residual cohort; the live page controls the conservative paper advance classification.
The current eVisa portal's Easy Visitor Permit tables directly name other nationalities and are not treated as an all-nationalities electronic complement. The Digital Arrival Card is also not a visa.

application.label: ICA Visitor Visa paper entry-permit application
steps: Use the current ICA Visitor Visa page to download the Application for Entry Permit Form.
Submit the paper visitor application before travel in accordance with ICA's current instructions.
Travel only after ICA has issued the visitor visa.

policies.title: Current reciprocal ordinary-passport visa-free admission
policies.summary: The current MFA Group II schedule directly names these passports for visa-free visitor entry, including regular/ordinary passports where specified.
conditions: This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline. Group II lists 90-day stays for all named codes except Qatar (30 days), China (30 days per entry and 90 days per 180), and Russia (90 days in a calendar year).

The Group II regime is not a work, study, long-stay, special-document, citizenship, final-admission, or entry-after-an-applicable restriction determination. The MFA expressly requires Qatar work or study visitors, and Maldives visitors exceeding 90 days or working/studying/doing business, to obtain a visa in advance.

policies.title: Hong Kong and Macao ordinary passports: temporary visa-free visitor waiver
policies.summary: The current MFA Group IV schedule directly grants holders of ordinary passports issued by Hong Kong and Macao SAR governments a temporary visitor waiver.
conditions: The waiver is limited to three entries during the stated period and up to 30 days on each entry. A valid visa is required for a fourth entry or after expiry.

This applies only to ordinary passports issued by the Hong Kong or Macao SAR governments; it is not transferred to mainland Chinese passports, other PRC documents, residence, work, study, special documents, citizenship, or final admission.

policies.title: Other recognized ordinary passports: consular advance visitor visa
policies.summary: These codes have no current MFA ordinary-passport visa-free rule or ASAN eVisa listing. The MFA's current default requires an entry visa and directs non-eVisa applicants to a consular single-entry application.
conditions: This policy is for a recognized ordinary passport used for tourism or personal travel. The current MFA describes tourism and personal travel as ordinary entry-visa purposes and requires pre-travel consular documents; it is not an eVisa conclusion from the MFA application portal.

ASAN eVisa eligibility is nationality-list limited. Airport visa issuance, third-country residence permits, direct-flight privileges, emergencies, Formula 1/event documents, transit, diplomatic, service, special, refugee, stateless and other travel-document routes are conditional and excluded.
Individual entry restrictions, passport validity, invitation/document requirements, carrier checks and final border admission remain applicable.

application.label: Azerbaijan consular single-entry visa application
steps: Apply to the relevant Azerbaijan diplomatic mission or consular section before travel with the completed application and valid ordinary passport.
For tourism, provide the stated hotel booking and inbound/outbound airline-ticket evidence.
Obtain the issued entry visa before travelling and meet final border-admission requirements.

policies.title: Non-waiver ordinary passports: advance territorial visitor permit
policies.summary: These ordinary-passport nationalities are absent from the current territorial visa-waiver list. American Samoa Immigration requires an approved 30-day visitor permit before travel; the non-waiver route is a sponsor-filed, in-person Immigration application, so it is normalized as visa_required rather than eVisa or arrival issuance.
conditions: This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline. The current territorial visa-waiver list is disjoint from this exact cohort; no mainland-US ESTA or federal visa classification is imported.

A traveler without a valid US visa, US visa-waiver-country citizenship, or green card needs an eligible local US-citizen-or-national sponsor to file the application in person at American Samoa Immigration, pay USD 40, and provide the stated passport, return-ticket and police-clearance materials.

The non-waiver application must be filed in person 3–5 business days before travel; after it is processed and paid, the sponsor sends the approved permit copy to the traveler, who must hand-carry it and present it on arrival. An applicant arriving without applying may be turned away.

A valid US visa or green card allows a distinct online territorial 30-day-permit workflow, but it is a traveler-specific document condition and still requires an approved permit before travel; it does not change this passport-wide baseline.

The permit is for a visitor stay up to 30 days, with a stated possible one-time 30-day extension. Sponsor, passport-validity, onward-ticket, police-clearance, fee, purpose, discretion and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Listed ordinary passports: mandatory preapproved, arrival-issued Tourist visa
policies.summary: Myanmar’s live official Tourist Visa notice lists these ordinary-passport nationalities and territories. Applicants must obtain an online approval letter before travel, but the visa itself is issued and stamped at the Myanmar Immigration Arrival counter; the easier visa-free policies above take precedence.
conditions: Tourist route only: obtain an approved eVisa Approval Letter before travel. The current FAQ says the visa itself is issued and stamped in the passport at the Myanmar Immigration Arrival counter, so the normalized status is visa_on_arrival.

The Terms and Conditions say an eVisa Approval Letter is not a confirmed visa. Print it and present it to the Immigration Officer on arrival; the FAQ says it is not a walk-up Visa on Arrival desk process.

Only an ordinary passport is accepted, with at least six months’ validity; a return ticket and booking at registered accommodation are required. Kawthaung land-border applicants may present a trip plan instead of a return ticket.

Entry is limited to Yangon, Mandalay, or Nay Pyi Taw international airports and Kawthaung International Land Border Checkpoint. The eVisa cannot be used for sea entry; cruises use a tour-agent pre-arranged visa-on-arrival route.
The approval letter is valid for 90 days from issue; the visa permits one tourist entry and up to 28 days after arrival. Processing takes at least three working days.

Travel to restricted areas requires separate confirmation. This policy does not establish business, work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special-document, security, or individual-admissibility rights.

application.label: Myanmar eVisa official service: required approval before arrival issuance
application.processingTime: At least three working days according to the current Tourist Visa notice and FAQ.
steps: Use the Tourist eVisa application with the same eligible ordinary passport intended for travel.
Upload the required passport and photograph documents, provide itinerary and registered-accommodation evidence, and pay by accepted card.
Receive and print the mandatory Approval Letter before travel; it is not the issued visa.
Present the letter and passport at an eligible Myanmar entry point, where Immigration issues and stamps the visa.

policies.title: Bahrain: named ordinary passports eligible for visa on arrival
policies.summary: The live NPRA Visa portal expressly names this exact residual cohort on its Countries Eligible to Get Visa on-Arrival list. The same nationalities also appear on the distinct online-visa list, but the available border-issued route controls this normalized visitor-access status.
conditions: Applies to a traveller holding the named nationality's own ordinary passport for a visitor entry; the FAQ requires each applicant to provide an individual passport.

The public NPRA Visa country lists separately label these nationalities as eligible online and eligible on arrival. This policy normalizes the directly available border-issued route as visa_on_arrival rather than treating optional online processing as the only route.
The arrival list says terms and conditions apply. The FAQ says a traveller must meet all conditions on arrival and entry remains at the Immigration Officer's discretion.

Visa type, duration, fees, extension, work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, stateless, and individual security/admissibility treatment remain outside this nationality-level visitor rule.

policies.title: Solomon Islands: gazetted concessional ordinary passports receive visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Legal Notice No. 128 remains the controlling published instrument specifying this concessional-entry cohort. Current Ministry guidance says members need not apply in advance and receive a visitor visa on arrival. The later unsigned delivery-policy repeal assertion does not identify or supply a later operative instrument capable of superseding the Gazette.
conditions: This is an ordinary-passport tourist/visitor baseline for the exact nationality cohort specified in Legal Notice No. 128; it is not visa-free admission.
The live Ministry guidance requires a passport valid for at least six months and a confirmed return or onward ticket. Immigration retains document, purpose, character and final-admission discretion.

The current Immigration tourist page describes visa-on-arrival availability, but its duration and generic online/grant-letter content conflict with other operational pages. No uniform stay, fee, entry count, port or online workflow is normalized.

The June/July 2026 delivery-policy PDF creates a material challenge because it claims the Minister repealed concessional arrival issuance. It has no approval date, approving authority, signature, operative repeal date, or citation to a later Gazette/legal notice; it is insufficient to retract this Gazette-based policy. Recheck if a later signed Gazette or ministerial instrument is published.

policies.title: Malaysia ordinary passports: Panama short tourist visit visa-free
policies.summary: Malaysia's current Lima Embassy guidance expressly says Malaysian passport holders do not require a visa for Panama tourism of up to 90 days.
conditions: Tourism only, for a stay not exceeding 90 days.
Use a valid Malaysian ordinary passport with at least six months' validity; the guidance also requires hotel booking and at least USD 500 proof of economic solvency.
Work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, emergency and other special-document routes, carrier requirements and final admission are not established by this policy.

policies.title: Philippine citizens: Bosnia and Herzegovina advance visa required
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's live MFA Philippines result expressly says Philippine citizens require a visa for entry, exit, or transit and identifies the responsible mission in Kuala Lumpur.
conditions: This is the short-visitor ordinary Philippine-passport baseline. The page states that Philippine citizens require a Bosnia and Herzegovina visa and says it shall be issued in Kuala Lumpur; it does not establish electronic issuance or a nationality-wide visa on arrival.
Diplomatic, official, residence, third-country-document, work, transit, and final border-admission exceptions are outside this baseline.

application.label: Bosnia and Herzegovina MFA Philippines consular result
application.processingTime: The live country result names Kuala Lumpur as the issuing location; it does not publish a decision-time promise.
steps: Use the responsible Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic-consular mission identified by the MFA result.
Obtain the visa before travel; the source does not describe an electronic or ordinary arrival-issuance route.

policies.title: Philippine ordinary passport: Kosovo advance consular visa required
policies.summary: Kosovo's current MFA platform omits the Philippines from its visa-free country list and directs unlisted foreign nationals to apply in person to the relevant mission before the visit.
conditions: The live schedule gives an explicit complement: a visitor who is not a citizen of a listed visa-free country and does not fall within a special category must apply for a Kosovo visa.

The current page requires in-person submission to the relevant diplomatic or consular mission no later than three months before the visit. It does not establish eVisa, ETA, or a Philippine-passport visa-on-arrival route.
A valid multiple-entry Schengen visa or qualifying biometric Schengen residence permit creates a separate document-conditioned exemption; it does not change the ordinary Philippine-passport baseline.
Diplomatic, official, special travel document, work, residence, transit, and final-admission rules are outside this classification.

application.label: Kosovo short-stay consular visa procedure
application.processingTime: Apply in person no later than three months before the visit; no decision-time promise is published.
steps: Apply in person to the relevant Kosovo diplomatic or consular mission.
Submit the completed original application and the requested travel, purpose, accommodation or means, insurance, and supporting documents.
Receive the visa decision before travel; possession of a visa does not automatically confer entry.

policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Panama stamped consular visa
policies.summary: Panama's current National Migration Service decree index expressly places India in the stamped-visa-by-consul cohort. The ordinary short-visitor baseline is therefore an advance consular visa, not an electronic or arrival-issued visa.
conditions: This records the ordinary short-visitor baseline without a separate conditional waiver based on a valid third-country visa or residence document.
It does not determine admission, transit, employment, residence, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, or special-document treatment.

policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Kyrgyz Republic Tourist eVisa
policies.summary: The live Kyrgyz MFA eVisa selector exposes Tourist (TS) after India is selected for the ordinary-passport application flow. The official portal says approval is an electronic visa confirmation received before entry, so this is an eVisa.
conditions: The ordinary short-visitor route is Tourist (TS), up to 30 days according to the official portal's visa-category information.
The traveller must complete the online application and receive electronic confirmation before entering; individual eligibility and border admission remain subject to the issuing authority.
This does not model the separate facilitated one-month route for qualifying Gulf resident-card holders or diplomatic/service treatment.

application.label: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa application
steps: Select India, Ordinary passport, and Tourist (TS).
Complete the online eVisa application and wait for electronic confirmation before travel.

policies.title: Valid PRC passport: Grenada short visitor visa-free
policies.summary: Grenada’s current MFA mission guidance expressly exempts citizens of the People’s Republic of China holding valid Chinese passports for visits not exceeding 30 days.
conditions: The rule is limited to a citizen of the People’s Republic of China holding a valid Chinese passport and a visit not exceeding 30 days.
The same current page says a Chinese permanent resident who is not a Chinese citizen must obtain a visa; residence is not generalized into this nationality baseline.
Work, study, residence, cruise-transit, diplomatic, official, service, and other special-document routes are outside this short-visitor ordinary-passport rule.
The online immigration and customs ED form is a pre-arrival declaration, not an ETA or visa.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: current named visa-required nationalities
policies.summary: The live Government visa service directs visa-required nationalities to its linked schedule; the approved visa is returned by email before travel and must be included before entry.
conditions: This applies to an ordinary passport of a nationality expressly named without a purpose limitation in the current Government-linked schedule, for a short visitor entry.
The service says an approved visa is returned by email; travel should not be booked until it is issued, and the entry FAQ requires any visa before entry.

Belarus, Moldova, Russia and Ukraine remain listed as visa-required for the ordinary baseline; the schedule limited mega-yacht waiver is a vessel-, duration-, and purpose-conditioned exception, not a nationality-wide substitute.
A valid UK, United States or Canadian visa may furnish a separate document-conditioned exemption for a visitor; it is not a nationality-wide ordinary-passport policy.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: Chinese ordinary passport tourism/business visitor exception
policies.summary: The current service-linked schedule limits the Chinese visa requirement to purposes other than tourism and business, establishing no advance visa requirement for the short tourism/business baseline.
conditions: Limited to an ordinary Chinese passport holder visiting for tourism or business.
The schedule expressly excludes Hong Kong SAR from its China row; that territorial wording is not generalized to Hong Kong or other special-document categories.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passport: visitor visa issued on arrival
policies.summary: Tonga Revenue's current named country cohort expressly includes Switzerland among travellers who may be issued a 30-day visitor visa on arrival.
conditions: The current Revenue source says the visitor visa may be issued on arrival for 30 days, subject to a valid return ticket to a country the traveller may enter and sufficient funds.

This is an arrival-issued visitor visa, not visa-free access or a pre-travel eVisa. Work, business, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service, and special-document routes remain outside this ordinary-passport visitor baseline.
The legacy Embassy page claims a longer Schengen-linked benefit, but its stated 2018 publication context is not controlling against the central current source.

policies.title: Non-waiver ordinary passports: Entry Visa required before arrival
policies.summary: Tonga Revenue states every country outside its current named arrival cohort needs a visa before arrival, while the current Ministry of Foreign Affairs Visitor's VISA checklist describes that non-waiver Entry Visa as issued in a letter format before arrival.
conditions: The current Revenue page supplies the complete residual rule: citizens of all other countries need visas before arrival.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs checklist expressly identifies an Entry Visa for Non-Waiver Countries issued as a letter before arrival. This is an advance visa route, not electronically issued eVisa or walk-up visa on arrival.
The legacy 2018 Embassy list names several additional visitor-arrival countries but does not reconcile its broader list with the central 2025/2026 sources; it is not used to widen the current cohort.
Return ticket, funds, purpose, work/business/study restrictions, immigration discretion, special documents, and final admission remain conditions outside the baseline.

policies.title: Named visa-and-clearance ordinary passports: advance visitor entry permission
policies.summary: GID's country schedule expressly places these passports in a category requiring both a visa and entry clearance; its entry rules require clearance approval before travel.
conditions: The Visa page expressly lists these countries as needing both visa and clearance.
GID requires approved entry clearance before arrival.
A border-issued visa cannot replace the named prior clearance.
GID describes sticker or endorsement issuance; no eVisa is established.
Work, residence, transit, health, security and special-document rules remain outside the visitor baseline.

policies.title: Named clearance-only ordinary passports: advance visitor entry permission
policies.summary: GID's country schedule expressly places these passports in its clearance-only category, and the entry page makes approved clearance a pre-arrival condition.
conditions: The Visa page expressly puts these countries in a clearance-only category.
GID requires approved entry clearance before arrival; this is advance permission, not visa-free access, ETA or eVisa.
A general border-visa statement does not remove an expressly required clearance.
Admission and special-document, residence, work and transit conditions are outside the baseline.

policies.title: Named visa-only ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: GID's country schedule expressly labels these passports visa-only, and its entry requirements expressly permit visa acquisition at a gazetted border.
conditions: The Visa page expressly puts these countries in a visa-only category, without entry-clearance language.
GID says a visa can be acquired at gazetted ports of entry; that route is normalized as visa on arrival.
GID describes sticker or endorsement issuance, not eVisa.
Admission, stay, work, residence, transit, health and security conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Guyana: MFA and ISS aligned ordinary-passport visa exemptions
policies.summary: The current Foreign Ministry and Immigration Support Services schedules each name these nationalities without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. This is visa-free short entry, not a landing permit, eVisa or visa-on-arrival classification.
conditions: Only explicitly named, unqualified ordinary-passport entries in both current schedules are included.
The schedules give different permitted periods for some shared nationalities, including the Dominican Republic and Panama; no uniform duration is assigned.
CARICOM movement language, landing permits, and special-document routes are not normalized as this ordinary-passport visa exemption.

policies.title: Guyana: MFA-named ordinary-passport visa exemptions
policies.summary: The current Foreign Ministry schedule directly names these nationalities without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. Their absence from the ISS schedule is not treated as a contrary visa requirement.
conditions: Only the Foreign Ministry’s express unqualified entries are classified.
The classification does not convert CARICOM movement language, a landing-permit application, or a third-country-document condition into a visa exemption.

policies.title: Guyana: ISS and consular-schedule ordinary-passport visa exemptions
policies.summary: The current ISS schedule and official consular Schedule 1 directly name Lesotho and Malaysia without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. MFA omission is not treated as a contrary rule.
conditions: The ISS schedule gives Lesotho 14 days and Malaysia 60 days; no broader duration, passport type or purpose is inferred.
Only the explicit unqualified entries are classified.

policies.title: Guyana: Bolivian ordinary-passport tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: ISS expressly identifies a tourist visa on arrival for Bolivian regular-passport holders. The official online process requires visa-on-arrival material and an approval letter before travel; the visa itself is issued at the port of entry, so this is not an eVisa.
conditions: The stated nationality route is limited to tourist entry with a regular passport.
Apply through ISS and obtain the emailed approval letter before travel; the immigration visa is issued at arrival.
This does not establish an electronic visa, walk-up visa without approval, work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document route.
No duration, port, entry-count, extension or fee is assigned beyond the reviewed guidance.

application.label: ISS visitor visa / visa-on-arrival approval application
steps: Submit the ISS visitor-visa application and its required supporting documents, including the mandatory visa-on-arrival request letter.
Travel only after receiving the ISS approval letter; present it so the visa can be issued at the Guyanese port of entry.
