policies.title: Guyana: foreign ordinary-passport advance-visa complement
policies.summary: The Immigration (Passports) Order establishes this foreign ordinary-passport visa-required baseline. A situational ISS alternative is available where a visa-required-country national cannot apply at a Guyanese mission: approval is obtained before travel and the visa is issued at the port of entry, which is visa_on_arrival rather than eVisa.
conditions: This is the ordinary-passport nationality baseline. It does not guarantee admission or remove immigration-officer discretion.

The official ISS visa-on-arrival alternative is situational, not a nationality-wide baseline: the traveller must be unable to apply at any Guyanese diplomatic mission. Those able to use a mission obtain a consular visa before travel.

The statutory residual group excludes a scheduled passport country, a reciprocal visa-free Commonwealth route, an individual ministerial exemption, or a visa-abolition agreement in force. No unverified exception is assumed.

Guatemala, Honduras and Mexico have published U.S.-permanent-resident or valid U.S., Canadian or Schengen-visa alternatives. Those document- or residence-conditioned exceptions are preserved and do not make their ordinary nationality passports visa-free.
Diplomatic, official, service, special, crew, work, study, business, landing-permit, transit and existing-visa routes are outside this short-visitor ordinary-passport baseline.
For a qualifying ISS applicant, the approval letter is required before boarding and the visa is stamped and issued at arrival. Preapproval does not make the border-issued route an eVisa.

application.label: ISS conditional visa-on-arrival approval application
steps: Use this alternative only if unable to apply at a Guyanese diplomatic mission; submit the ISS visitor-visa application and required visa-on-arrival materials.
Carry the successful ISS approval letter for boarding; the visa is stamped and issued at the Guyanese port of entry.

policies.title: Venezuela: foreign ordinary passports eligible for electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: The current Foreign Ministry tourist-visa manual expressly says the visa will be granted to foreign natural persons entering for recreation, health or non-remunerated activities, and its workflow ends with an approved, electronically signed document. Venezuela's Embassy in France calls the Tourist (T) category an electronic visa and directs applications to the Foreign Ministry's Cancillería Digital portal. This maps the exact currently unsupported foreign ordinary-passport cohort from direct nationality-general eligibility and electronic issuance evidence, not from portal existence or omission from the air-entry exemption list.
conditions: The Foreign Ministry manual directly states that the tourist visa will be granted to foreign natural persons whose entry is for recreation, health or activities without remuneration or profit. It requires a passport valid for at least six months, a photograph, application form and request letter; approval remains subject to the stated process and final admission.

The source expresses eligibility as a nationality-general foreign-person rule, not as an inference from the named air-entry exemption list. This policy maps only the catalog ordinary passports in the exact currently unsupported foreign cohort; it does not establish diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, stateless, laissez-passer, identity-document or other special-document treatment.

Applicants create a request with the Office of Consular Relations, select and register the tourist-visa procedure, attach the required documents and submit the request through Cancillería Digital. The Foreign Ministry manual says the approved document is electronically signed, emailed and available to download as a PDF; it says the procedure is approved and signed in approximately 72 hours.

Venezuela’s Embassy in France labels Tourist (T) visas electronic and links applicants to the exact Foreign Ministry login. The mission-specific page proves the electronic Tourist (T) issuance route but does not establish a different nationality list, a universal consular-jurisdiction rule, a fee, an appointment rule or universal duration, entry-count or stay terms.

This is an advance electronically issued visa, not an ETA, visa on arrival, airport-only facility or an inference that every foreigner must use the portal. The separately named 71 ordinary passports remain visa-free only for the Foreign Ministry’s explicit tourist air-entry scope; no land- or sea-entry exemption, transit, work, study, residence, citizenship, bilateral identity-document or third-country-document rule is inferred.

application.label: Venezuela Foreign Ministry Cancillería Digital
application.processingTime: The Foreign Ministry manual says the procedure is approved and signed in approximately 72 hours.
steps: Register in Cancillería Digital and create the tourist-visa request with the competent Office of Consular Relations.
Complete the tourist-visa procedure and upload the passport, photograph, application form, request letter and any mission-required documents.
Submit the request and receive the approved electronically signed document by email; download the signed PDF before travel and meet final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Cambodia: expressly supported residual ordinary-passport Tourist Visa T on arrival
policies.summary: For the currently unsupported ordinary-passport cohort below, Cambodia's current official Embassy guidance establishes issuance of a visitor visa directly on arrival rather than relying on eVisa-portal universality.
conditions: The Embassy page says a traveler without an entry visa can obtain the visa directly on arrival, which establishes issuance timing at the airport, listed land posts or listed sea ports; the live GDI e-Arrival service also identifies Electronic Visa On Arrival as a current service component. This is not an inference from an eVisa selector or application portal.

The same Embassy page expressly requires Afghanistan, Algeria, Saudi Arabia, Bangladesh, Iran, Iraq, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Sudan and Nigeria to obtain a visa before departure. Those ten passports are excluded from this residual cohort and are assigned by the carried prior-visa policy.

The Embassy page was live-rechecked on 22 August 2026 but contains other stale material, including explicitly transitional 2024 e-Arrival wording and a 2023 exemption image. Neither live GDI nor re-openable MFA/eVisa material supplied a current exhaustive nationality schedule; this confined residual cohort remains medium confidence and requires rechecking.

The traveler must present a passport valid at least six months, a return or onward ticket and a recent photograph, and complete the form on site. Some carriers may require an entry visa before boarding.

This is a Tourist Visa T visitor-route finding only. It does not establish work, residence, extensions, repeated-entry, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien or other special-document treatment.

The GDI arrival service corroborates the current existence of electronic VOA processing but does not by itself establish nationality eligibility. Cambodia e-Arrival is not classified as an ETA; admission remains subject to Cambodian immigration and carrier requirements.

policies.title: Cuba tourist visa: live exemption schedule
policies.summary: The current Cuban Foreign Ministry eVisa country schedule marks thirteen listed nationalities as visa-exempt for tourist entry; Cuba Travel separately confirms the Chinese regular-passport exemption.
conditions: This is the live eVisa tourist-nationality schedule only. It does not establish work, study, residence, transit, special-passport, document, route or final-admission treatment.
Cuba Travel lists valid passport, medical insurance, return ticket, D'VIAJEROS QR code and final immigration admission among the remaining entry conditions.
Cuba Travel expressly describes China as a regular-passport exemption; the live eVisa schedule is the direct source for the other named nationalities.

policies.title: Cuba tourist eVisa: live non-risk nationality schedule
policies.summary: For the named active nationalities that the current Cuban Foreign Ministry eVisa schedule neither marks visa-exempt nor risk-routed, the ordinary tourist request remains available through eVisa-Cuba and the issued visa code is sent by email before travel.
conditions: Each named nationality is an active record in the live Cuban Foreign Ministry eVisa schedule with librev false and riesgo false. This is a direct schedule-based assignment, not an inference from portal branding, a nationality field or an unlisted country.

Cuba Travel states that a tourist visa is mandatory for a traveller without Cuban residence, gives the internet route, and says the tourist receives a visa code and payment proof by email. The live service describes the electronic visa as linked to the valid passport.

The route is limited to an ordinary short tourist visit. Cuban citizenship, residence, work, study, transit, family, crew, special-document and final-admission conditions remain outside this classification.
Applications made from the United States have the distinct purchase arrangement stated by Cuba Travel; that place-of-application condition does not change the passport-nationality route.

application.label: eVisa-Cuba tourist visa application
application.processingTime: The live eVisa service states that a response is issued within the next 72 business hours.
steps: Choose the country of application, Cuban consulate and nationality in eVisa-Cuba.
Provide the valid passport and required personal and payment information, then submit the tourist-visa request.
Receive the visa code and payment proof by email before travelling, complete D'VIAJEROS, and present the required travel documents for entry.

policies.title: Cuba tourist visa: live consular-risk nationality schedule
policies.summary: The current Cuban Foreign Ministry eVisa schedule marks these nationalities riesgo; its application blocks the ordinary online tourist request and directs the traveller to contact a Cuban consulate to process the visa.
conditions: The application’s risk routing is a direct current instruction to contact a Cuban consulate for visa processing; it is not an electronically issued tourist-visa route.
This excludes residence, purpose-specific, special-document, transit and final-admission rules.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: visa-free under the current bilateral abolition agreement
policies.summary: Botswana's Government states that the Rwanda visa-abolition agreement took immediate effect on 6 May 2026 and that Botswana was implementing it. This current destination-government rule supersedes the older eVisa classification.
conditions: The source establishes visa abolition for Rwandan citizens; it does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Botswana's current visitor guidance states a maximum stay of 90 days in each calendar year; ordinary passport validity and other border conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Mozambican ordinary passports: current Commonwealth exemption
policies.summary: Botswana's current Government guidance exempts citizens of Commonwealth countries other than seven named exceptions. Mozambique is a current Commonwealth member and is not one of those exceptions.
conditions: The exemption is derived from Botswana's express current Commonwealth rule, together with official confirmation that Mozambique is a Commonwealth member; the seven named visa-required Commonwealth countries do not include Mozambique.
The sources do not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Botswana's current visitor guidance states a maximum stay of 90 days in each calendar year; ordinary passport validity and other border conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: current visa-free entry under the bilateral agreement
policies.summary: The Russian Foreign Ministry's current consular table states that Russian citizens enter Botswana visa-free for up to 90 days and links the 2019 bilateral agreement on mutual abolition of visa requirements for citizens. Botswana's current Government guidance confirms that nationals covered by a visa-abolition agreement do not require a visa.
conditions: The Russian Foreign Ministry table states visa-free entry for Russian citizens for up to 90 days. It separately distinguishes the older diplomatic-and-service-passport agreement from the 2019 agreement covering citizens.
The sources do not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Botswana's current visitor guidance states a maximum stay of 90 days in each calendar year; ordinary passport validity and other border conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Mongolian ordinary passports: bilateral visa waiver
policies.summary: The current MIREX ordinary-tourist selector says Mongolian ordinary passports do not require a visa and that the measure has been in force since 10 June 2026. The Dominican Constitutional Court reproduces the underlying bilateral agreement, which waives visas for valid ordinary passports for stays of up to 90 days.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary Mongolian passport for entry, stay, departure or transit for no more than 90 days from entry under the bilateral agreement.
A stay exceeding 90 days requires a visa in advance. Purpose-specific immigration, passport-validity, transport-carrier, security screening and final-admission requirements remain separate.

DGII’s Tourist Card list continues to name Mongolia as visa-required. The targeted current MIREX ordinary-passport tourist result and the agreement’s reproduced ordinary-passport scope are preferred for this direct conflict; recheck operational guidance if either authority changes it.
This policy does not establish residence, work, study, crew, diplomatic, official, service, special-document or individual-admissibility treatment.

policies.title: Other ordinary adult visitor passports require a Korean visa
policies.summary: For the listed ordinary passports, a visitor must obtain a Korean visa before standard short entry because the current official entry guide expressly says countries absent from the K-ETA eligibility list must apply for a visa.
conditions: This is the ordinary adult-passport, standard short-visitor baseline; it does not establish work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, United Nations, crew, ABTC, cruise, or other special-document treatment.
The cited April 2026 Ministry of Foreign Affairs entry guide ties the complement to absence from the live K-ETA eligibility list and expressly directs an unlisted country to apply for a visa.

The result is not inferred from portal silence: the same official guide expressly identifies narrow exceptions for Korean nationals, age groups, registered foreigners, valid-visa holders, transfer or transit routes, and other special categories.

The guide separately directs readers to the Jeju visa-free and transfer-passenger schemes. Those itinerary- or destination-specific exceptions do not establish an unconditional ordinary-passport classification for Korea as a whole.

The temporary K-ETA exemption remains effective through 31 December 2026 (KST) for its separately listed passports; no code in this policy is in the current K-ETA eligibility or temporary-exemption groups.

policies.title: Philippine ordinary passports: Angola tourist-visa exemption
policies.summary: A current Government/CIPRA retrospective identifies the Presidential instrument integrating the Philippines into Angola’s tourist-visa-exemption regime. The original regime’s tourism-only purpose and ordinary border formalities continue to limit this classification.
conditions: Tourist visits only; the Government source does not establish work, study, medical-treatment, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service or special-document treatment.
The reviewed current Government confirmation establishes the current inclusion but does not publish the amending decree’s operative-text PDF or a precise effective date; no date is normalized here.
Normal border admission and document requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina: directly replayed residual ordinary-passport advance-visa cohort
policies.summary: The MFA's current, individually selected nationality cards expressly require an entry/transit visa for this ordinary-passport residual cohort. The cards route issuance through a Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic or consular mission; this is an advance visa, not a nationality-wide eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: This is the ordinary visitor-passport baseline from the directly replayed MFA inbound country cards. It excludes diplomatic, official, service, business, residence, employment, transit-only and final-admission cases.

A separate conditional waiver for a traveller holding a qualifying multiple-entry Schengen, EU or United States visa or qualifying residence permit is not generalized to the nationality-only baseline.
The Rulebook's individual urgent border-visa procedure is not a nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route.

policies.title: Hong Kong SAR passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The MFA's current China card expressly exempts Hong Kong SAR passports from Bosnia and Herzegovina's visa regime for entry, exit and transit, up to 90 days in six months from first entry.
conditions: This applies to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport described by the MFA, not a PRC ordinary passport, a Macao SAR passport, a Taiwan passport or a business, diplomatic or residence document.
The stated short-stay limit is up to 90 days during six months from first entry. Work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: Saudi eVisa registration
policies.summary: The current official Saudi eVisa regular-passport selector includes Taiwan China, and its linked nationality authorization endpoint returns isAuthorized 1. This establishes a pre-travel electronic visa application route for ordinary Taiwan passports.
conditions: The route is an online eVisa application before travel, not visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry. The portal's displayed visa fee is 300 SAR before any other applicable charges.
The registration flow identifies the passport type as Regular Passport and the selected nationality as Taiwan China; its authorization response is reproduced at the cited official endpoint.

This policy does not establish access through a third-country visa, foreign residence, GCC residence, package travel, pilgrimage, transit, work, study, diplomatic or official documents. Final issuance and admission remain subject to the Saudi authorities' application and border decisions.

The separate Visit Saudi nationality dataset currently labels Taiwan China noneligible. The live eVisa issuance portal is given precedence for the eVisa route because it directly accepts the regular-passport nationality and exposes an authorized application continuation.

policies.title: Current EU, Commonwealth and ECOWAS ordinary-passport short-visit exemption
policies.summary: The central Government's current visitor page expressly exempts United Kingdom, full EU, Commonwealth and ECOWAS citizens for holiday or business visits not exceeding 90 days. This later central guidance resolves contrary rows in GID's older nationality table.
conditions: Only holiday or business visits not exceeding 90 days are within this policy.
The cited central guidance describes citizens; this candidate normalizes the ordinary-passport visitor baseline only.
Employment, residence, transit, health, security and admission-screening requirements are outside this baseline.
This current central guidance supersedes only the table rows that directly contradict its named membership categories.

policies.title: ECOWAS transitional visa-free movement for Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger
policies.summary: Although Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger withdrew from ECOWAS, its current official transition statement directs all ECOWAS member-state authorities to continue visa-free movement for their citizens until further notice.
conditions: The ECOWAS instruction is expressly temporary: it applies until further notice.
The Gambia is a current ECOWAS Member State and is within the authorities addressed by the instruction.
This is limited to the ordinary visitor-access baseline; other admission conditions remain outside scope.

policies.title: Named reciprocal ordinary-passport visa exemptions outside membership groups
policies.summary: GID's current nationality table expressly names San Marino, Tunisia and Russia in its visa-exemption-agreement category. Indonesia is excluded because the same table separately calls for entry clearance.
conditions: The policy uses only named states not already covered by the Government's membership-group exemption.
The GID schedule's contradictory Indonesia rows are deliberately held rather than normalized.
Admission, security, health, work, residence and transit requirements are outside scope.

policies.title: Named visa-and-entry-clearance ordinary passports
policies.summary: GID's live nationality schedule expressly assigns these passports to both visa and entry-clearance categories. The current entry guidance requires an approved clearance before travel, so they remain advance-permission access rather than eVisa, ETA or arrival issuance.
conditions: The schedule explicitly says both visa and clearance are required for this cohort.
GID requires a copy of approved entry clearance for travel; its stated validity is 30 days.
The GID service describes visas as stickers or endorsements, not electronic issuance.
Work, residence, transit, health, security and special-document rules remain outside the ordinary visitor baseline.

policies.title: Named entry-clearance-only ordinary passports
policies.summary: GID's live nationality schedule expressly places these passports in clearance-only categories. Its entry guidance makes approval a pre-arrival condition, not an ETA, eVisa, visa-free route or arrival-issued visa.
conditions: The schedule expressly identifies this cohort as requiring entry clearance only.
GID says clearance must be approved before arrival and carried for entry.
The clearance format and application channel are not established as an ETA or eVisa.
Admission, work, residence, transit, health, security and special-document conditions remain outside scope.

policies.title: Named visa-only ordinary passports: visa issued at entry
policies.summary: GID's live nationality schedule calls these passports visa-only, without clearance. Its current entry guidance expressly makes a visa available from immigration officers at gazetted ports, establishing arrival issuance for this named cohort.
conditions: The GID schedule explicitly separates this visa-only cohort from the entry-clearance categories.
GID says a visa can be acquired from immigration officers at gazetted ports of entry.
The service describes sticker or endorsement issuance, not an eVisa.
Admission, work, residence, transit, health, security and special-document requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Named foreign nationals: Grenada visa exemption
policies.summary: The Immigration (Visa) Regulations in Grenada’s current Chapter 145 legal record expressly exempt these named nationalities from Grenada visa requirements. These entries add only countries not already covered by the EU–Grenada waiver or the current China-specific MFA guidance.
conditions: The statutory text expressly names citizens of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, San Marino, Switzerland and the United States as exempt from visa requirements.
Venezuelan citizens are expressly exempt only if they possess valid return or onward tickets.

The legislation concerns visa requirements; it does not guarantee admission, a particular permitted stay, work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, crew, refugee, stateless or other special-document treatment.
The 2021 MFA nationality table is not used to infer treatment of any unlisted nationality because no later operative replacement schedule was recovered.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: Guyanese nationals exempt from a visa
policies.summary: The current, in-force 2024 BVI amendment adds nationals of Guyana to the Visa Exemption Order. S.I. No. 26 of 2026 is a separate, narrowly framed exemption for certain children born in the Territory and does not amend that nationality rule.
conditions: This maps the nationality-based visa exemption only for an ordinary visitor passport; admission, length of stay, and other entry requirements remain discretionary.
S.I. No. 26 of 2026 concerns children under 11 born in the Territory to ordinarily resident parents and is not a nationality visitor schedule.

policies.title: Kosovo ordinary passport: citizenship
policies.summary: A Kosovo national travelling on a Kosovo ordinary passport is classified as citizenship, rather than as a foreign visitor-visa relationship.
conditions: Article 35 says Kosovo citizens may not be denied entry. This does not classify a dual national presenting another country's document.
Residence, work, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency-document and final border-admission treatment are outside this classification.

policies.title: Listed foreign ordinary passports: visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Kosovo's live MFA schedule names these nationalities as not requiring a short-stay visa, subject to the separately recorded signed amendments and special-document limits.
conditions: This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor classification. The MFA's web contact form and downloadable application do not establish an eVisa, ETA, or visa-on-arrival route.
The Interior Ministry permits a short stay of up to 90 days in every 180 days, subject to a valid travel document, stated purpose, means, address registration, security checks, and final admission.
The MFA separately lists biometric-ID-card and Schengen-document routes. Those document-conditioned exceptions do not broaden this ordinary-passport policy.

Fiji remains unresolved because its later signed amendment makes effectiveness conditional on Gazette publication; Botswana, Namibia, and South Africa are covered by the signed 2024 amendment instead.

policies.title: Hong Kong and Macao travel documents: visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Kosovo expressly exempts valid travel documents issued by the Hong Kong and Macao administrations from the visa requirement.
conditions: This is limited to a valid travel document issued by the named administration; it does not make a recognition, citizenship, diplomatic, residence, work, or other-document inference.
The current Interior short-stay and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Taiwan travel documents: visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Kosovo exempts Taiwan-issued travel documents, and signed Decision No. 21/216 removes the prior advance-notification condition printed on the live MFA page.
conditions: This is limited to a Taiwan-issued travel document and makes no recognition, citizenship, diplomatic-status, or other-document inference.
A waiver does not remove ordinary travel-document, purpose, means, registration, security, or final-admission checks.

policies.title: Ukraine ordinary passport: temporary visa waiver
policies.summary: Official Gazette Decision No. 14/67 suspends Kosovo's entry-visa regime for Ukrainian citizens until a subsequent Government decision.
conditions: The Gazette states that the waiver remains in force until a later Government decision. No later official revocation was directly retrieved in this review.
This does not establish an eVisa, ETA, arrival-visa, work, residence, or special-document entitlement.

policies.title: Other foreign ordinary passports: advance consular visa required
policies.summary: For these ordinary passports, Kosovo's MFA gives an express visa-required complement and requires an in-person application to the relevant diplomatic or consular mission before a visit or transit.
conditions: The MFA's express complement, not mere omission from a list, supports this baseline. The application must be submitted in person to the relevant Kosovo diplomatic or consular mission; no eVisa, ETA, or nationality-wide arrival-visa route is established.

The published process requires an original application, travel document, purpose, accommodation or means, insurance, and other supporting evidence. Possession of a visa does not automatically confer entry.
A valid biometric Schengen residence permit or valid multiple-entry Schengen visa can create a separate 15-day document-conditioned exemption. It does not change this passport-only baseline.

Russia is expressly excluded from that Schengen-document exception by the Gazette decision. Diplomatic, official, refugee, stateless, UN/NATO/OSCE/EU travel-document, identity-card, residence, work, and transit-specific routes are outside this classification.

application.label: Kosovo short-stay consular visa procedure
application.processingTime: Apply in person no later than three months before the visit; the page publishes no decision-time promise.
steps: Apply in person to the relevant Kosovo diplomatic or consular mission.
Submit the completed original application, travel document, purpose and accommodation or means evidence, insurance, and other requested documents.
Receive the visa decision before travel; possession of a visa does not automatically confer entry.

policies.title: Turkish ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye’s Foreign Ministry currently directs Turkish citizens travelling to Afghanistan to obtain the purpose-appropriate visa, including tourist visas, from Afghanistan’s Ankara Embassy or Istanbul Consulate before travel.
conditions: This is a nationality-specific Turkish-citizen short-visitor rule: obtain the appropriate visa, including a tourist visa, from Afghanistan’s Embassy in Ankara or Consulate General in Istanbul before travel.
The current Ankara mission page lists normal processing as five business days and express processing as one day. This timing is service-specific and not a guarantee of issuance.
This does not establish visa-free, eVisa, visa-on-arrival, diplomatic/service-passport, Afghan-origin, residence, third-country-document, work, transit, or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo free visa on arrival
policies.summary: The Republic of the Congo’s ratified Rwanda agreement gives holders of an ordinary passport issued by either Party a free visa at entry to the other Party, valid for no more than 90 days.
conditions: Applies only to a Rwandan citizen holding an ordinary passport when entering the Republic of the Congo. The agreement expressly distinguishes ordinary passports from the diplomatic and service-passport exemption.

The visa is issued free at entry and is valid for a stay not exceeding 90 days. The agreement entered provisionally into force on signature on 24 November 2021, is for an indefinite period, and is currently listed in the Republic of the Congo's ratified-agreement register.

The agreement requires use of border crossings for international traffic and preserves each Party's power to refuse entry or shorten a stay for an undesirable person. Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, service, special-document, carrier and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Libya: active ordinary-passport electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: E-VISA LIBYA's current active country configuration positively lists these ordinary-passport nationalities with no exemption, online application and EMAIL visa delivery; the same national portal makes Electronic Visa available and includes tourism and visit purposes.
conditions: The live country configuration expressly marks each listed code as active, not exempt, online-applicable and EMAIL-delivered. It is a current electronic issuance route rather than a visa-on-arrival or mere online preapproval.

Use a regular ordinary passport and select a current visitor purpose (tourism or visit) in E-VISA LIBYA. The portal's nationality, date-of-birth and gender checker, supporting-document requirements, payment, carrier rules and final border admission still apply.

application.label: E-VISA LIBYA public nationality eligibility checker
steps: Choose the regular-passport nationality, gender and date of birth in the official eligibility checker.
If the official checker permits the route, create the electronic-visa application and select tourism or visit as appropriate.
Complete the portal's document, payment and any review requirements; travel only after the visa has been issued and delivered by the service.

policies.title: Libya: current full ordinary-passport visitor exemption
policies.summary: E-VISA LIBYA's current active country configuration explicitly marks these ordinary-passport nationalities with FULL exemption rather than an electronic-visa requirement.
conditions: This is limited to the ordinary short-visitor setting represented by the live national eligibility configuration. It does not establish treatment for diplomatic or service passports, residence, work, group travel, or other special cases.
Passport validity, the live eligibility check, carrier requirements and final border admission remain separate.

policies.title: Central African Republic: existing named ordinary-passport advance visas
policies.summary: Current passport-specific government guidance already retained in canonical evidence requires advance visas for these named visitors.
conditions: Carried forward solely for this full-scope candidate. The sources expressly identify ordinary visitor visa requirements before travel or mission processing; no general residual complement is inferred.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passport: existing Central African Republic visa-free entry
policies.summary: Rwanda’s current DGIE ordinary-passport schedule expressly records Central African Republic as visa-free.
conditions: Carried forward solely for this full-scope candidate; this named ordinary-passport row is not an inferred regional complement.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: current legal electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: The current registered MFA e-Visa requirements expressly name these nationalities in Annex 3. The legally operative schedule has contained 42 names since 25 March 2025, when the MFA removed Grenada, Peru and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines; the live MFA page's unenumerated 43-state count is retained as a source discrepancy but does not negate the 42 directly named legal routes.
conditions: This is the directly named ordinary-passport e-Visa eligibility cohort in the registered current legal schedule, not a complement inferred from portal availability or omission.

MFA resumed actual e-Visa issuance on 19 February 2025. The legal Annex 3 has 42 names after its 25 March 2025 amendment, while the live MFA e-Visa page says 43 and the February resumption notice said 45 without a roster; the unidentified count discrepancy is retained and no forty-third nationality is inferred.

An e-Visa may be single or double entry and up to 30 days for the listed visitor purposes. It is issued online before travel; this policy does not establish visa-free, visa-on-arrival, residence, work, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, stateless, third-country-document, carrier, or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: United Kingdom ordinary passports: temporary visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Presidential Decree No. 921/2025 extends visa-free entry and transit for United Kingdom citizens through 30 January 2027 for stays up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The decree applies to citizens of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland for entry and transit, limited to 90 days in any 180-day period.

The Decree entered into force on publication. This ordinary-passport visitor baseline does not establish work, residence, special-document, border-access, carrier, security or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: 2024 RMI diplomatic-ties ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current Parliament-hosted regulations issue a visitor visa upon arrival to citizens of countries with RMI diplomatic ties. The Ministry’s 2024 report directly records that the Republic established ties with each named country; ordinary visitors are therefore mapped as visa_on_arrival.
conditions: A visitor visa is issued upon arrival under regulation 7 only after the Director is satisfied about the return ticket, local address, and any other necessary information.
The visitor visa is valid for 90 days under regulation 7; issuance and final admission remain subject to immigration clearance and the Director’s statutory discretion.
This is an ordinary-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not infer eligibility for diplomatic, official, residence, employment, crew, sponsor, or other special routes.

policies.title: Jamaican ordinary passport: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current Parliament-hosted regulations issue a visitor visa upon arrival to citizens of countries with RMI diplomatic ties. Jamaica’s Foreign Ministry directly records the 2022 joint communiqué establishing ties with the RMI; the ordinary visitor route is therefore visa_on_arrival.
conditions: A visitor visa is issued upon arrival under regulation 7 only after the Director is satisfied about the return ticket, local address, and any other necessary information.
The visitor visa is valid for 90 days under regulation 7; issuance and final admission remain subject to immigration clearance and the Director’s statutory discretion.
This is an ordinary-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not infer eligibility for diplomatic, official, residence, employment, crew, sponsor, or other special routes.

policies.title: Nepali ordinary passport: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current Parliament-hosted regulations issue a visitor visa upon arrival to citizens of countries with RMI diplomatic ties. Nepal’s current Foreign Ministry bilateral-relations dataset directly records the RMI relationship; the ordinary visitor route is therefore visa_on_arrival.
conditions: A visitor visa is issued upon arrival under regulation 7 only after the Director is satisfied about the return ticket, local address, and any other necessary information.
The visitor visa is valid for 90 days under regulation 7; issuance and final admission remain subject to immigration clearance and the Director’s statutory discretion.
This is an ordinary-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not infer eligibility for diplomatic, official, residence, employment, crew, sponsor, or other special routes.

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passport: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current Parliament-hosted regulations issue a visitor visa upon arrival to citizens of countries with RMI diplomatic ties. Qatar’s Foreign Ministry directly records its joint statement with the RMI establishing those ties; the ordinary visitor route is therefore visa_on_arrival.
conditions: A visitor visa is issued upon arrival under regulation 7 only after the Director is satisfied about the return ticket, local address, and any other necessary information.
The visitor visa is valid for 90 days under regulation 7; issuance and final admission remain subject to immigration clearance and the Director’s statutory discretion.
This is an ordinary-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not infer eligibility for diplomatic, official, residence, employment, crew, sponsor, or other special routes.

policies.title: Antigua and Barbuda ordinary passport: visa on arrival
policies.summary: RMI's current Parliament-hosted regulations issue a visitor visa upon arrival to citizens of countries with RMI diplomatic ties. RMI's Foreign Affairs Ministry directly announced the formalization of ties with Antigua and Barbuda in September 2025.
conditions: A visitor visa is issued upon arrival under section 6 only after the Director is satisfied about the return ticket, local address, and any other necessary information.
The visitor visa is valid for 90 days under section 6; issuance and final admission remain subject to immigration clearance and the Director's statutory discretion.
This is an ordinary-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not infer eligibility for diplomatic, official, residence, employment, crew, sponsor, or other special routes.

policies.title: Guyanese ordinary passports: Albania visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Guyana's current Foreign Ministry outgoing schedule expressly states that Guyanese travellers do not require a visa for Albania for stays of up to 90 days.
conditions: The published exemption is limited to stays not exceeding 90 days; the source does not specify a separate rolling reference period.
Admission, passport validity, purpose-of-stay evidence, work, study, residence, transit and other individual requirements remain outside this ordinary short-visitor classification.

policies.title: Guyanese ordinary passports: Grenada and Panama visa-free visits
policies.summary: Guyana's current Foreign Ministry outbound schedule says Guyanese travellers do not require visas for Grenada and for Panamanian tourism stays not exceeding 90 days.
conditions: Panama is limited to tourism stays not exceeding 90 days; the schedule states no uniform stay limit for Grenada.
Admission, passport validity, work, study, residence, transit and other individual requirements remain outside this ordinary short-visitor classification.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: Guinea-Bissau arrival visa
policies.summary: The current Macao DSI passport-specific record classifies Guinea-Bissau as visa on arrival, rather than visa-free access, for the Macao SAR Passport.
conditions: This applies only to the Macao SAR Passport, not to a PRC passport, Hong Kong document, Portuguese passport, residence document or other travel document.
The DSI record identifies Osvaldo Vieira International Airport as the arrival-visa location and states a maximum period of 90 days.
Purpose, passport validity, fees, carrier requirements and final admission remain subject to the Guinea-Bissau authorities.

policies.title: HKSAR passports: Ukraine visa-free visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current bilateral agreement permits Hong Kong SAR permanent residents holding the HKSAR Passport to enter, leave, transit and stay in Ukraine without a visa for no more than 14 days.
conditions: The agreement applies to a Hong Kong SAR permanent resident using the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Passport expressly named in its annex.
A stay longer than 14 days, or entry for employment, study or residence, requires a visa before travel.
Temporary return documents and other Hong Kong, PRC, BN(O), diplomatic, official, service or residence documents are outside this modeled ordinary-passport relationship.
Final admission and compliance with Ukrainian migration, security, health and public-order law remain subject to the competent authorities.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance says a valid visa is required before travel and that Burkina Faso entry and stay visas are delivered primarily online through eVisaburkina.
conditions: This is the ordinary French-passport visitor baseline. A visa must be valid before travel; print and retain the electronically issued visa for presentation on arrival.

The separate online fiche voyage is an immigration form, not a visa or ETA. Consular processing, dual Burkinabè nationality, residence, special passports, work, transit, carrier checks and final admission are outside this baseline.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Sierra Leone arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance says French nationals remain able to obtain a visa on arrival at Freetown airport while Sierra Leone's online visa system is not yet fully operational.
conditions: The stated ordinary French-passport route is border issuance at Freetown airport. It is not classified as an eVisa merely because the guidance also directs short-stay applicants to an online immigration site before departure.

The source describes an operationally incomplete online system; confirm live carrier and airport arrangements before travel. Residence, work, transit, special passports and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Iran preapproved arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance expressly includes France among nationalities that may obtain a short-stay private-travel visa at certain Iranian airports after online preregistration.
conditions: Complete the required online preregistration and present its printed proof on arrival. The visa is issued at specified airports, so the route is preapproved arrival issuance, not an electronically issued visa.

This route is limited to short private travel and requires an ordinary passport; the source expressly excludes diplomatic and service passports. Embassy visa processing, work, residence, transit, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current French government guidance says a visitor with a valid passport may obtain a Jordanian visa on arrival at Queen Alia airport or at any border crossing.
conditions: Use a passport valid for at least six months at arrival. The optional Ministry of Interior online route and online multiple-entry option do not change the separately stated border-issuance baseline.
Jordan Pass, Aqaba, group-tour, diplomatic-passport, transit, residence, extension, carrier checks and final-admission conditions are separate from this ordinary visitor baseline.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Burkina Faso's electronically issued short-stay visa before travel.
conditions: Apply online before travel; the Federal Foreign Office says a visa-on-arrival request is accepted only in urgent exceptional cases and is not reliable for a normal visitor baseline.
The official Burkina Faso embassy guidance says approved applicants receive the EVISA document by email and present it at the border.
This excludes work, residence, transit, diplomatic or special documents, the separate entry-form QR code, and final admission.

application.label: Visa Burkina official eVisa service
steps: Apply online for the intended short-stay visitor visa before travel.
Receive the approved EVISA document by email and present it at entry.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Iran electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Germany's current official guidance says the Iranian visa for a German national is electronically issued and can be applied for online before entry.
conditions: Carry the electronically issued visa as a printout; it is not placed in the passport.
The same guidance says that the reliability of the arrival-visa process since the COVID-19 pandemic is not confirmed and urgently advises against relying on it.
This excludes German-Iranian dual nationals, non-tourist purposes, exit-visa procedures, security conditions, and final admission.

application.label: Iran Ministry of Foreign Affairs eVisa service
steps: Apply online before entry using the German ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Carry the electronically issued visa printout and meet Iranian entry requirements.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Jordan's visitor visa on arrival at the named airports and certain land crossings.
conditions: Arrival issuance is available at Queen Alia International Airport and Aqaba Airport; the guidance also names Aqaba/Yitzhak Rabin and Sheikh Hussein Bridge for arrival issuance.
Entry via King Hussein Bridge from the West Bank requires a visa applied for online before entry; that route is a material exception, not a nationality-wide replacement for the airport arrival route.
Purpose, passport validity, payment, route operations, stays over 14 days, security conditions and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors must obtain the Sudanese visa before entry through the competent Sudanese mission.
conditions: For Germany-based applicants, the current guidance identifies the Embassy of the Republic of Sudan in Berlin.
This does not normalize travel warnings, airport operations, registration after entry, travel permits, non-visitor purposes, special documents or final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Syria advance visitor visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors require a Syrian visa applied for through the competent Syrian foreign mission before travel.
conditions: For an applicant resident in Germany, the current guidance identifies the Syrian Embassy in Berlin.
Visa issuance is not always possible at Syrian land crossings; this does not establish an electronic or dependable arrival-visa route.
This excludes Israeli-document restrictions, transit, work, residence, special documents, operational access and final admission.

policies.title: United States ordinary passport: North Macedonia short visitor stay
policies.summary: Current State Department guidance establishes a visa-free ordinary U.S.-passport tourist or business visit to North Macedonia for less than 90 days in six months.
conditions: The visa-free scope is tourism or business for less than 90 days within a six-month period.
Work, study, longer stays, passport validity, medical insurance, registration, admission, and dual-nationality rules remain outside this classification.

policies.title: United States ordinary passport: specified arrival-issued visitor visas
policies.summary: Current State Department guidance expressly provides arrival-issued visa routes for ordinary U.S. passports in Guinea-Bissau and Jordan.
conditions: GW: a visa is required and may be obtained on arrival; advance embassy application is also available.

JO: visas are issued on arrival at Queen Alia International Airport and most international land crossings, but not at King Hussein (Allenby Bridge); stay, fee, registration, Jordan Pass, e-application, purpose, document, and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: United States ordinary passport: expressly pre-travel visitor visas
policies.summary: Current State Department guidance expressly requires an ordinary U.S.-passport visitor to obtain a visa before travel to Liberia or Niger.
conditions: LR: all tourist visits require an advance visa; a traveler without one may be deported immediately.
NE: an advance visa is required; destination-specific passport, yellow-fever, security, carrier, entry-point, and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: United States ordinary passport: Sierra Leone pre-travel visitor visa
policies.summary: Current State Department guidance requires an ordinary U.S.-passport visitor to obtain a Sierra Leone visa before travel.
conditions: The visa is required regardless of the length of stay and must be applied for before travel.
The separately paid airport-security fee is not a visa or an arrival-issuance route.

policies.title: United States ordinary passport: Paraguay short visitor stay
policies.summary: Current State Department guidance establishes visa-free ordinary U.S.-passport tourism or business access to Paraguay for up to 90 days.
conditions: The scope is private U.S. citizens visiting for tourism or business for up to 90 days.
Passport validity, child-travel, departure-tax, special-document, and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: United States ordinary passport: Côte d’Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: A U.S.-passport visitor must request approval online before arrival, while Côte d’Ivoire's current official procedure prints and issues the visa after airport biometrics.
conditions: Complete the online request and obtain approval before travel; the visa itself is printed and issued after biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport.
The ordinary visitor must also satisfy passport, yellow-fever, carrier, entry-point, and final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Netherlands guidance expressly directs a Dutch passport holder who needs a Burkina Faso visa to Visa Burkina, whose official procedure confirms electronic visa issuance.
conditions: Use an ordinary Dutch passport and complete the electronic application and payment before travel. This is electronic issuance, not the separate travel form or an arrival visa.
Embassy, migration-service, residence, work, transit, special-document, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire preapproved arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Netherlands guidance directs Dutch passport holders requiring a Côte d’Ivoire visa to SNEDAI; its official process requires online pre-enrolment then prints and issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Dutch passport. Complete SNEDAI pre-enrolment, payment and required documents, receive the approved response, and carry it when boarding.

The visa is printed and issued after biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport. This is preapproved border issuance, not an eVisa. ECOWAS, residence, work, transit, diplomatic or other special-document routes remain separate.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Netherlands guidance expressly says a Dutch-passport holder can buy a Jordan visa at the airport or a Jordanian border office.
conditions: Use an ordinary Dutch passport valid for at least six months on arrival. The online Ministry of Interior E-visa is an alternative route and does not alter the stated arrival-issuance baseline.
Jordan Pass, group tourism, transit, Hajj, diplomatic passports, residence, extensions, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: Bangladesh visitor visa on arrival

Carry the approved pre-enrolment document to Abidjan airport.
Complete biometrics at the airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: Jordan airport-issued tourist visa

policies.title: British citizen passports: specified visa-free visitor stays
