policies.title: Ordinary passports: sponsored electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Oman's Royal Oman Police offers tourists of all nationalities a sponsored 30-day tourist visa. The authority classifies sponsored tourist visas within its eVisa system and sends approved visas electronically before travel.
conditions: A tourism company licensed in Oman must sponsor the application. This is not an unsponsored eVisa entitlement, visa exemption, visa on arrival, or ETA.
The tourist visa is valid for 30 days and may be extended for a similar period. The application must be approved before travel; an approved electronic visa is sent to the registered email address.

Use a valid ordinary passport and meet the sponsor, application, payment, supporting-document, carrier, border-control, and final-admission requirements. Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, emergency, refugee, stateless, and other special-document treatment remain outside this policy.

Afghanistan, DPRK, and Palestine remain outside this batch under the project's conservative direct-evidence rule. Taiwan remains outside because current Omani authority lists diverge on its visa-free treatment.

application.label: Royal Oman Police eVisa service
steps: Arrange sponsorship through an Oman-licensed tourism company and submit the tourist visa application through the Royal Oman Police eVisa system.
Complete the required documents and payment, then wait for approval before departure.
Retain the electronic visa sent to the registered email address and present it with the same passport for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Sri Lankan ordinary passports: Bangladesh advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's current High Commission guidance requires Sri Lankan nationals to obtain a Bangladesh visa endorsement before visiting; the official MRV service requires printed mission submission.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Sri Lankan passport holder seeking a short visitor stay in Bangladesh.
Obtain the Bangladesh visa endorsement before travel; the online MRV form must be printed and taken with supporting documents and payment to a Bangladesh visa office or mission.
The High Commission lists visitor supporting-document requirements; work, residence, transit, official or special-passport treatment and final admission are outside scope.

application.label: Bangladesh online MRV and mission submission
steps: Complete the official online MRV form.
Print the form and assemble the required documents and visa-fee payment.
Submit them to the nearest Bangladesh visa office or mission before travel.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: operative electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: The registered operative e-Visa requirements expressly name this 42-passport Annex 3 cohort. Actual electronic issuance resumed on 19 February 2025; the listed route is an advance eVisa, not portal inference.
conditions: This is the directly named ordinary-passport Annex 3 cohort in the in-force legal schedule; no eligibility is inferred from omission, portal availability, or an unenumerated country count.
MFA resumed electronic issuance on 19 February 2025. The 25 March 2025 amendment removed Grenada, Peru, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, leaving these 42 directly named routes.

The advance e-Visa is single or double entry for up to 30 days within the listed visitor purposes. Residence, work, transit, diplomatic, official, emergency, refugee, stateless, carrier, and final-admission treatment are not established here.

policies.title: United Kingdom ordinary passports: temporary visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Presidential Decree No. 921/2025 extends the United Kingdom citizen visa waiver through 30 January 2027 for stays up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The decree applies to citizens of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland for entry and transit, limited to 90 days in any 180-day period.
This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline only; it does not establish work, residence, special-document, border-access, carrier, security, or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Bhutanese ordinary passports: Bangladesh visa on arrival
policies.summary: Bhutan's current Foreign Ministry notice confirms that Bhutanese passport holders may use Bangladesh's visa-on-arrival facility.
conditions: Applies to a Bhutanese ordinary passport holder visiting Bangladesh for a short stay.
Visa issuance is at arrival; carry accommodation details in Bangladesh and a return air ticket.
Military and security officials must complete formalities with the Bangladesh Embassy in Thimphu before travel.
Residence, work, study, transit, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Nepali ordinary passports: Bangladesh tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Bangladesh's current Kathmandu Embassy guidance allows a Nepali national a single-entry tourist visa at a Bangladesh international airport once yearly.
conditions: Applies to a Nepali ordinary passport holder visiting Bangladesh for tourism.
A 30-day single-entry visa may be issued at any Bangladesh international airport once per year.
Bangladesh's general eligibility selector currently returns a conflicting mission-visa result; the newer passport-specific Embassy guidance controls this policy.
Residence, work, study, transit, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Israel, North Macedonia and Mexico ordinary passports: 30-day visa-free visit
policies.summary: The live MFA eVisa selector directly returns Visa free regime, up to 30 days, in the Ordinary Passport column for Israel, Macedonia and Mexico.
conditions: Direct selector replay used the page's country IDs 109 (Israel), 131 (Macedonia, mapped to North Macedonia/MK), and 143 (Mexico), then POSTed each doc_issued_by value to getVisaTypeInfo in the same PHP session.

Each returned ordinary-passport value is Visa free regime up to 30 days. No electronic, border-issued, diplomatic, service, residence, work, transit, security, carrier, or individual-admission route is inferred.
The response is session-bound and mutable; recheck the live official selector before travel. The portal labels MK as Macedonia rather than North Macedonia.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Eswatini visa-free visits
policies.summary: Serbia's current Foreign Ministry Eswatini guidance expressly says ordinary Serbian passports do not require a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian passport for a short visitor trip; the source does not publish a visitor-stay duration.
The passport must be valid for six months from intended entry and have two blank pages.
Diplomatic, official, travel-document, residence, work, study, transit and final-admission circumstances are outside this baseline.

policies.title: Barbadian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea short-visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Barbados's current Foreign Affairs outbound schedule expressly records no visa requirement for Equatorial Guinea and says the waiver agreement covers all passport categories.
conditions: Applies to a Barbadian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor; the schedule's waiver remark covers all passport categories.

The live Barbados Foreign Affairs page currently links the country schedule. It gives no nationality-wide short-stay duration, work, residence, transit or admission terms for this row; none is inferred.
Border, health, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate from the visa waiver.

policies.title: Maldivian ordinary passports: Cambodia visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current Maldivian MFA guidance says the bilateral Cambodian visa exemption took effect on 4 May 2023 and covers ordinary passports for up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies to a valid Maldivian ordinary passport for entry, transit, stay and departure of no more than 30 days from entry.
A longer stay, work, study or business requires an appropriate visa before travel.
Final immigration admission and ordinary entry-document requirements remain applicable.

policies.title: Bolivian ordinary passports: Bahamas visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The Bahamas' live visitor requirements table directly marks a Bolivian passport as not requiring a visa for a three-month visit; current legislation's designated-country rule is consistent with that visitor result.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bolivian passport visitor for up to three months in the official country table.
Work, education, residence, special travel documents and final immigration admission are outside this visitor baseline.
The table retains an internal 2014 date despite current Bahamas government hosting; current designated-country legislation is used only as legal corroboration, not as a general omission inference.

policies.title: DR Congo ordinary passports: Bahamas advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Bahamas legislation expressly designates the Democratic Republic of Congo as visa-required and defines the visa as a consular endorsement placed in the passport; its eVisa site supports online filing but not electronic issuance.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Democratic Republic of the Congo passport visitor for leisure; the Regulations categorize tourist visas as leisure travel.
The visa is an endorsement in the passport issued by or for the Minister after consular examination; online filing does not make this an electronically issued visa.
A single-entry tourist visa is valid for one entry within three months; final admission remains subject to Immigration Act requirements.

policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Peru advance tourist visa
policies.summary: Peru's current ordinary-passport table marks India visa-required by default and waives that requirement only for holders of specified third-country visas or permanent residence. The current Embassy procedure requires advance application and in-person processing in New Delhi.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Indian passport holder visiting as a tourist without the table's qualifying United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia or Schengen visa or permanent-residence exception.

Apply before travel through the Embassy of Peru in New Delhi. The current procedure requires consular submission and an in-person interview and says processing normally takes 7 to 10 working days after the interview.

The source states a multiple-entry tourist visa validity of up to 183 days. Work, residence, transit, special documents, qualifying-document exceptions and final admission remain outside this baseline.

application.label: Peruvian Embassy in India tourist-visa procedure
steps: Prepare the ordinary passport and the documents required by the official Embassy procedure.
Submit and process the application through the Embassy of Peru in New Delhi before travel.
Attend the required in-person interview and wait for the consular decision before travelling.

policies.title: Macao SAR ordinary passports: El Salvador advance Special Entry Permit
policies.summary: Macao's current passport authority directly maps the ordinary Macao SAR Passport to El Salvador's online application route. Salvadoran Immigration requires a favourable PEI decision before travel and treats the resulting passport-stamped permit as equivalent to an entry visa, so it remains an advance visa route.
conditions: Applies to the ordinary Macao SAR Passport short-visitor route expressly mapped by DSI to El Salvador's PEI service.

Complete the PEI application and receive a favourable result before travel; the approved product is equivalent to an entry visa and is not a walk-up visa on arrival, ETA or electronically issued visa.

DGME stamps the approved Special Entry Permit in the passport on entry through an air, sea, or land border. Purpose, stay, supporting documents, final admission, residence, work, diplomatic, official, service, and special-document routes are outside scope.

application.label: El Salvador Special Entry Permit (PEI)
steps: Register and submit the Special Entry Permit application through the official PEI service before travel.
Wait for the approval notification before travelling to El Salvador.
Present for entry so that DGME stamps the Special Entry Permit in the passport.

policies.title: Vanuatu: Moldovan ordinary passports require an electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Moldova MFA's current passport-category table directly states that a Moldovan ordinary passport requires a Vanuatu visa and identifies eVisa as its method; Vanuatu Immigration requires non-exempt travellers to obtain approval before travel.
conditions: Applies only to an ordinary Moldovan passport holder travelling for a short visitor or tourist purpose.
The Moldovan Foreign Ministry's table is explicitly updated 20 February 2026 and places eVisa in its visa-obtainment-method field for the ordinary-passport Vanuatu row.
Vanuatu Immigration says non-exempt travellers must apply and obtain approval before travel. This is pre-travel electronic issuance, not visa-free entry or a visa issued on arrival.
No duration, entries, fee, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document, third-country-document, or final-admission rule is inferred.

policies.title: Türkiye: Cambodian ordinary passports require an advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry register directly says ordinary Cambodian passport holders require a visa. Its current visa-process guidance directs non-exempt visitors to obtain visas or schedule a Turkish consular appointment, establishing advance consular issuance rather than a passport-wide electronic visa.
conditions: Applies only to an ordinary Cambodian passport holder travelling for a short visitor or tourist purpose.
The register separately exempts official Cambodian passports; that official-passport rule is not applied to ordinary passports.

The applicable route is a pre-travel Turkish consular/sticker-visa process. No arrival issuance, electronic eligibility, duration, entries, fee, work, residence, transit, special-document, or third-country-document route is inferred.

policies.title: Ecuador: HKSAR ordinary passports visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ecuador's reciprocal Visa Abolition Agreement expressly gives HKSAR passport holders visa-free visits up to 90 days; the live HKSAR Immigration Department list continues to show Ecuador with a 90-day stay.
conditions: Applies to HKSAR passport holders visiting Ecuador for up to 90 days under the reciprocal Visa Abolition Agreement.
The 1999 agreement took effect on 3 October 1999; the current HKSAR Immigration Department Ecuador entry still displays a 90-day stay.
Employment, residence, study, non-HKSAR travel documents, passport validity, health, security and final border-admission requirements remain outside this short-visitor policy.

policies.title: Nicaraguan ordinary passports: Tanzania visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Tanzania's operative visa controls expressly require a visa without prior approval for countries outside the current statutory visa-free schedule; the current schedule does not contain Nicaragua. The statutes permit issuance at designated entry points, and current Immigration guidance confirms that arrival issuance is a route for obtaining a Tanzanian visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nicaraguan passport holder travelling as a short visitor, not to Tanzanian citizens, dual-citizenship exceptions, diplomatic, service, official, refugee, stateless, residence, work, business, transit or other special-document cases.

The visa requirement follows the statutory rule for a country outside the replacement Third Schedule, rather than an inference from a portal or a non-exhaustive web list. Nicaragua is not a country in that complete legal schedule.

Nicaragua is likewise absent from the complete statutory referral schedule, which is the only category requiring Commissioner-General approval; the 2025 amendment alters that schedule only by deleting Somaliland.

The statutory entry-point issuing station and current Immigration arrival route support visa-on-arrival normalization. Passport validity, return/onward travel, funds, health requirements, application requirements and final Immigration Officer admission remain applicable.

policies.title: South Korean ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Republic of Korea Foreign Ministry South Sudan guidance says ordinary passport holders are not visa-free, visa-on-arrival issuance has stopped, and online visa issuance is available. The South Sudan Interior eVisa service delivers the visa PDF before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Republic of Korea passport holder visiting South Sudan; it does not establish treatment for South Sudanese nationals, dual nationals, diplomatic, official, service, emergency or other travel documents.
The Republic of Korea source reports that visa-free entry for ordinary passports is unavailable and visa-on-arrival issuance has stopped; it identifies online visa issuance as the available route.

Apply through South Sudan's official eVisa service, create an account, submit the visa application and pay online. After approval, download the eVisa PDF before travel; admission and other entry conditions remain for South Sudan authorities.

application.label: South Sudan eVisa application
application.processingTime: The official portal says the eVisa PDF is downloadable within 72 hours.
steps: Create an account on the official South Sudan eVisa service.
Complete the visa application and pay the application fee online.
After approval, download the eVisa PDF before travelling.

policies.title: South Korean ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Korean MFA requires an approved eVisa pre-enrolment document before departure for ordinary Korean passports. Côte d’Ivoire’s recognised official service prints and issues the biometric visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary Republic of Korea passport for a short visitor trip; diplomatic, official, service, residence, work, transit and final-admission rules are outside this finding.
Complete the approved online pre-enrolment before boarding and carry the approved response, payment receipt, passport and other listed entry documents.
At Abidjan airport, complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is advance electronic preapproval followed by arrival issuance, not electronic visa issuance.

application.label: Côte d’Ivoire official eVisa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the ordinary-passport pre-enrolment and payment online.
Receive the approved pre-enrolment response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: South Korean ordinary passports: Eswatini visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Korea MFA’s current Eswatini entry panel states that ordinary Republic of Korea passport holders are visa-free for up to 60 days under the stated arrangement.
conditions: The entry panel states a 30-day visa-free stay, extendable by a further 30 days after entry, for a maximum stated 60 days.
This is limited to the ordinary short-visitor baseline; work, residence, special documents, extension approval and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: South Korean ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Korea MFA’s current Grenada entry panel states that ordinary Republic of Korea passport holders have an agreement-based visa waiver for 90 days.
conditions: The stated maximum short stay is 90 days under the agreement-based waiver.
This is limited to ordinary passports and short visits; non-tourist purposes, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: South Korean ordinary passports: Mali advance mission visa
policies.summary: Korea MFA’s current Mali entry panel says ordinary Republic of Korea passport holders must obtain a visa in advance through the Malian Embassy in Japan or another competent mission.
conditions: Obtain the visa before travel through the Malian Embassy in Japan or another competent Malian mission.
The MFA warns that a traveller without a visa may be refused boarding or entry.
This is limited to ordinary short visitors; diplomatic and official passports, work, residence, transit and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: South Korean ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Korea MFA’s current Trinidad and Tobago entry panel states that ordinary Republic of Korea passport holders have an agreement-based 90-day visa waiver.
conditions: The stated maximum short stay is 90 days under the agreement-based waiver.
This is limited to ordinary passports and short visits; non-tourist purposes, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Bangladesh advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgaria's current Foreign Ministry guidance says Bulgarian citizens need a visa issued in advance to travel to Bangladesh.
conditions: Applies to a Bulgarian ordinary passport holder making a short visitor trip to Bangladesh.
The visa must be issued before travel; the guidance directs travellers to contact a Bangladesh diplomatic mission.
The guidance also requires passport space for the entry visa to be affixed.
Work, residence, transit, special passports, Bangladeshi-origin documents and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Bangladesh tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Argentina's current Embassy guidance says Argentine citizens may obtain Bangladesh's visa on arrival for qualifying short tourist or business stays.
conditions: Applies to an Argentine ordinary passport holder visiting for tourism or business for up to 30 days.
Visa issuance is at a Bangladesh international airport, including Dhaka; carry a passport valid at least six months, return ticket and hotel reservation.
The route is not visa-free: issuance and admission depend on the local immigration authorities' decision.
The notice says online visa processing is not available to Argentine citizens; work, residence, transit and special passports are outside scope.

policies.title: Kosovo ordinary passports: Mauritius advance visa
policies.summary: Mauritius's current government consular page expressly says Kosovo passport holders need a visa and must apply at least one month before departure.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary Kosovo passport for a short visitor trip; diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien and other travel documents are outside this finding.
Apply for the visa at least one month before departure for Mauritius; this is an advance-visa baseline, not electronic or arrival issuance.
Final admission, passport validity, return travel, accommodation, funds, work, residence, transit and any individual immigration-officer conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Kosovo ordinary passports: Uruguay advance consular visa
policies.summary: Uruguay's current exhaustive common-passport schedule requires citizens of countries absent from the table, including Kosovo, to obtain a consular visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary Kosovo passport for a short visitor trip; diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien and other travel documents are outside this finding.
Uruguay's schedule expressly requires a prior consular visa for citizens of countries not present in its common-passport table, and Kosovo is not present.
Apply through a competent Uruguayan consulate before travel; the current consular procedure says applications must be made at least 30 business days before the trip.

policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Pakistan advance tourist visa
policies.summary: Pakistan's live DGIP Indian-national page requires a valid visa and says the short tourist visa is issued by the Pakistan High Commission in New Delhi before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Indian passport holder undertaking a short tourist visit; the published tourist visa is non-extendable and valid for 14 days.
The tourist visa is issued in advance by the Pakistan High Commission in New Delhi through approved tour operators or travel agents.

The page requires a valid passport and application; visitor, business, transit, Indian-origin, residence, work, religious-tourism, diplomatic/official documents, border-route, police-reporting, security and final-admission arrangements are outside this baseline.

policies.title: Grenada: named ordinary passports exempt from visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked citizenship schedule directly marks these passport issuers No Visa required.
conditions: Applies to ordinary passport holders travelling as short visitors under the nationality category directly named in Grenada's schedule.
Argentina is explicitly limited by the schedule to a 30-day visitor stay; no duration is inferred for the other named passport codes.

The schedule's no-visa label concerns entry-visa requirements only. Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment remain outside this finding.
The actively linked PDF has inconsistent cover and page-level update marks and should be rechecked before promotion or travel reliance.

policies.title: Grenada: named ordinary passports require visitor visa before travel
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked citizenship schedule directly places these passport issuers in its Prior to Arrival category, defined as a mission or consulate visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to ordinary passport holders travelling as short visitors under the nationality category directly named in Grenada's schedule.
The schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel; it is not an eVisa or arrival-issued visa.
Purpose-specific, work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment remain outside this finding.
The actively linked PDF has inconsistent cover and page-level update marks and should be rechecked before promotion or travel reliance.

policies.title: Grenada: named ordinary passports receive visitor visa at port of entry after pre-clearance
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked citizenship schedule places Belarus and Kazakhstan in its Port of Entry category; the linked instructions require pre-clearance before travel, followed by visa issuance on arrival in Grenada.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Belarusian or Kazakh passport holder travelling as a short visitor under the nationality category directly named in Grenada's schedule.
The schedule defines Port of Entry as a visa granted on arrival in Grenada, not an electronic approval or a visa-free admission.

Before travel, apply for a Grenada Immigration and Passport Office pre-clearance letter; the live instructions recommend applying at least six weeks before departure. The visa itself is granted on arrival in Grenada.
Purpose-specific, work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment remain outside this finding.
The actively linked PDF has inconsistent cover and page-level update marks and should be rechecked before promotion or travel reliance.

policies.title: Hong Kong SAR ordinary passports: 30-day Georgian tourist waiver
policies.summary: Georgia's Foreign Ministry directly includes Hong Kong SAR passport holders in its 30-day visa-free tourist rule, corroborated by the HKSAR passport authority.
conditions: Applies to a Hong Kong SAR passport holder visiting Georgia for tourism for up to 30 days.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and other document categories remain outside this ordinary short-visitor finding.
Entry remains subject to Georgia's border, admissibility, security and public-order rules.

policies.title: Georgia MFA live ordinary-passport country results: advance visitor visa
policies.summary: For each named ordinary passport, Georgia's live MFA eligibility response says a visa is needed and no electronic visa is available. The controlling law places non-electronic visa issuance with the MFA, missions and consular offices abroad.
conditions: The live country results for Nicaragua, Venezuela, Nauru and the Syrian Arab Republic each return NeedVisa true and CanGetVisa false. The result is used with the application's Ordinary passport selection only.

This is the ordinary-passport, short visitor baseline without relying on a separate valid third-country visa or residence-permit exception. The response marks a supporting-document field; any document-conditioned exception is outside this passport-only policy.

The law assigns regular visa issuance to the MFA, Georgian diplomatic missions and consular offices abroad; its electronic route is separately issued through the MFA special webpage. The live result expressly denies that electronic route for this cohort.
Issuance and entry remain subject to the statutory visa application, refusal, security, public-order, funds, insurance, border and territorial rules.

policies.title: Romanian and Samoan ordinary passports: Tourist Card without consular visa
policies.summary: Dominican Republic Decree 690-07 expressly names Romania and Samoa for tourist entry with a Tourist Card. Current MIREX ordinary-passport results independently attribute both no-visa outcomes to that decree.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary Romanian or Samoan passport for tourist travel only, under Decree 690-07's named Tourist Card route.

The Tourist Card is a tax/formality, not an ETA, eVisa, visa on arrival or consular visa. DGII states that it permits a tourist stay of up to 30 days and is normally included in foreign-issued air tickets.

Work, study, residence, business, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, border-card, special-document, security-screening and final-admission treatment are outside this short-visitor baseline.

policies.title: Albanian ordinary passports: advance Dominican tourist visa baseline
policies.summary: DGII directly names Albania among tourists who cannot enter with a Tourist Card and must obtain a visa at a Dominican mission. MIREX's contrary result invokes only the qualifying-document Decree 691-07 exception.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Albanian passport holder who does not hold the qualifying third-country residence or multiple-entry visa document specified in Decree 691-07.

DGII requires a tourist from Albania to obtain a visa at a Dominican diplomatic mission. MIREX states the consular service response time is 10 to 20 business days, so this is an advance visa rather than electronic or arrival issuance.

Decree 691-07 permits tourist entry with a valid passport and Tourist Card only for a traveller with permanent residence or a valid multiple-entry visa for the United States, Schengen/EU area, Canada or the United Kingdom; that conditional exception is not this baseline.
Work, study, residence, business, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, border-card, special-document, security-screening and final-admission treatment remain outside this finding.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: UAE advance tourist visa
policies.summary: The UAE Embassy's current Taiwan record marks Regular passports Visa Required; its non-exempt visitor instructions require obtaining the tourist-visa copy before travel.
conditions: Applies only to the UAE Embassy's Taiwan Regular-passport category and an ordinary short tourist visit.
A visa on arrival is restricted to exempt nationalities with the appropriate passport type; Taiwan Regular is marked Visa Required.
For a tourist visit, the Embassy says UAE visa agents or hotels process the visa and that the traveller must receive a copy before travel.
This does not establish an eVisa, airline transit visa, GCC-resident route, work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or final-admission rule.

policies.title: Mongolian ordinary passports: Paraguay short tourist visa waiver
policies.summary: Paraguay's live migration schedule directly gives Mongolia a Law 7206 tourist visa waiver for up to 30 days. Law 7206 covers ordinary passports, and Mongolia MFA independently records Paraguay as visa-free for all passport types.
conditions: Applies only to an ordinary Mongolian passport visiting Paraguay as a short tourist; residence, work, study, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are excluded.

The Paraguayan National Migration Directorate's current operational schedule fixes the supported tourist stay at up to 30 days. Mongolia MFA publishes 90 days, so this policy assigns no uniform duration beyond the Paraguayan authority's stated limit.

Paraguay MFA's separate country-list page omits Mongolia and states a generic unlisted-country visa rule. That is a live publishing conflict, but it does not mention Law 7206; the MFA's own live visa FAQ directs nationality determinations to the Migration Directorate schedule, which expressly maps Mongolia.
No eVisa, visa-on-arrival, application-form, third-country-document, residence, reciprocity or final-admission entitlement is inferred.

policies.title: Macao SAR ordinary passports: Iran visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Macao's current passport-specific DSI record directly identifies Iran as visa-free for the Macao SAR Passport, with a maximum stay of 21 days.
conditions: Applies only to the ordinary Macao SAR Passport selected in DSI's live Travel Convenience Privilege service.
The direct DSI record states a maximum stay of 21 days and marks visa-on-arrival and eVisa false.
Visitor purpose, passport validity, admission, security, itinerary, transit, residence, work and all non-ordinary document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Macao SAR ordinary passports: Pakistan electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Macao's current passport-specific DSI record maps Pakistan to eVisa. Pakistan's current immigration authority confirms applicants apply online from their home country and receive electronic authorization to travel before arrival.
conditions: Applies only to the ordinary Macao SAR Passport selected in DSI's live Travel Convenience Privilege service.
Apply online from the home country and receive electronic authorization before travel; show it to immigration for passport stamping on arrival.
The policy does not establish business, work, residence, pilgrimage, diplomatic, official, service, group-tour, special-document or final-admission treatment.

application.label: Pakistan Online Visa System
steps: Apply through Pakistan's official online visa system from the home country.
Receive the electronic authorization to travel before departure.
Present the authorization to immigration for passport stamping on arrival.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA directly requires a visa for Serbian national passports, and Chad's current immigration authority requires all new non-diplomatic visa applications exclusively through evisa.td.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Serbian-passport short visitors, which Serbia's MFA directly identifies as visa required.
Submit the new visa request exclusively through evisa.td before travel; diplomatic and courtesy visas remain outside this electronic route.
Purpose, security checks, duration, final admission, transit, work, residence, official, diplomatic and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

application.label: Chad official eVisa application
steps: Submit the new visitor-visa request through evisa.td before travel.
Complete the electronic application and any requested immigration checks.
Travel only with the approved visa and required admission documents.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA says the bilateral visa regime applies to national passports and identifies Sudan's Bucharest diplomatic-consular mission as responsible for issuing visas.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian national passport for a short visit.
Obtain the entry visa through Sudan's competent diplomatic-consular mission in Bucharest before travel; Serbia's MFA says the described route requires a Sudanese inviter or host.
Mission availability, security, sponsor verification, final admission, transit, work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Syria advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA directly requires a visa for Serbian citizens and identifies the Syrian Embassy in Belgrade as the available advance-issuance route.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian passport for a short visitor trip.
Obtain the visa at the Syrian Embassy in Belgrade before travel. Serbia's MFA says the formal border route has been uncertain since hostilities began.
Mission availability, security, final admission, transit, work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA directly says Serbian passport holders do not need a Trinidad and Tobago visa for stays up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies to holders of Serbian ordinary passports for stays up to 30 days.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: South Sudan eVisa
policies.summary: Current Australian Government guidance directs Australian travellers to South Sudan's eVisa department for a visa issued before travel, while the official issuer delivers an approved downloadable PDF.
conditions: Applies to an Australian visitor using an ordinary passport and travelling despite the Australian Government's do-not-travel advice.

Apply before travel through the South Sudan Department of E-Visa and Immigration Services. The issuer says an approved eVisa PDF can be downloaded within 72 hours; processing and approval are not guaranteed.

Carry the approved PDF for verification and passport stamping at the port of entry. Passport validity, yellow-fever certification, security restrictions, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

application.label: South Sudan eVisa service
application.processingTime: The official service says the downloadable PDF is available within 72 hours after approval.
steps: Create an account and complete the eVisa application before travel.
Pay the application fee and wait for a decision; approval is not guaranteed.
Download the approved PDF and present it with the passport at the port of entry.

policies.title: Emirati normal passports: South Sudan eVisa
policies.summary: The UAE Foreign Ministry's current South Sudan page directly selects the normal passport and directs UAE nationals to the official South Sudan eVisa issuer, which provides an approved downloadable PDF before travel.
conditions: Applies to UAE nationals using a normal passport; the UAE page includes tourism among the stated purposes and describes a 30-day stay beginning on the specified arrival date.
Apply before travel through the South Sudan eVisa service. The issuer says an approved eVisa PDF can be downloaded within 72 hours; processing and approval are not guaranteed.
Present the approved PDF for verification and passport stamping at the port of entry. Passport validity, purpose-specific documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

application.label: South Sudan eVisa service
application.processingTime: The official service says the downloadable PDF is available within 72 hours after approval.
steps: Create an account and complete the eVisa application using the UAE normal passport before travel.
Pay the application fee and wait for a decision; approval is not guaranteed.
Download the approved PDF and present it with the passport at the port of entry.

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Comoros visa on arrival
policies.summary: Croatia's current Foreign Ministry visa table selects the ordinary passport and states that Croatian nationals can obtain a Comoros visa on arrival for up to 45 days.
conditions: Applies to a Croatian citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit of up to 45 days.
The official page establishes arrival issuance but does not publish the fee or supporting-document requirements; confirm these before travel.
Passport validity, purpose restrictions, carrier requirements and final border admission remain separate.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Comoros visa on arrival
policies.summary: Montenegro's current government country page states that its citizens receive the required Comoros visa at an airport or border crossing for a 45-day stay.
conditions: Applies to a Montenegrin citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit of up to 45 days; special-document routes are outside this policy.
The required visa is issued upon arrival at an airport or border crossing.
Fees, passport validity, supporting documents, carrier requirements and final border admission must be confirmed before travel.

policies.title: Ordinary U.S. passports: North Korea travel restriction
policies.summary: U.S. Passport Services states that ordinary U.S. passports are invalid for travel to, in or through North Korea. A separately issued special-validation passport is limited to national-interest cases and is not an ordinary short-tourist route.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary U.S. passport for travel to, in or through North Korea.
Passport Services may issue a special-validation passport only on a limited national-interest basis, including qualifying journalism, Red Cross work or compelling humanitarian cases.
A special validation is a separate passport exception and does not itself decide DPRK admission or replace any DPRK entry permission.

policies.title: Regular Canadian passports: North Korea advance visa
policies.summary: Canada's current regular-passport guidance requires a tourist visa and says it is obtained before travel from a DPRK mission in a third country after approval from Pyongyang.
conditions: Applies to a regular Canadian passport; official and other travel documents may follow different rules.
The visa is obtained from a North Korean mission in a third country after approval from the government in Pyongyang, and the process may be slow.
The passport must remain valid for at least six months beyond expected departure; journalists need special permission and may not use a tourist visa.
Border operations, organized-tour requirements, carrier rules and final admission remain separate and can change.

policies.title: Australian passports: North Korea advance visa
policies.summary: Australia's current travel guidance requires a visa for every travel type and directs applicants to obtain it in a third country because no DPRK mission operates in Australia.
conditions: Applies to Australian travellers using an ordinary passport for a short visit; journalists and business travellers follow additional permission or sponsorship rules.
The visa must be obtained before travel in a third country such as China or Indonesia because there is no DPRK embassy or consulate in Australia.
Travel is limited to an official tour with an accompanying guide; sanctions may also affect payments connected to a visa or organized travel.
Entry conditions, carrier rules and final admission remain separate and may change at short notice.

policies.title: Chinese private ordinary passports: North Korea advance visa
policies.summary: China's current consular guidance requires private ordinary-passport holders to obtain a DPRK visa or tourism certificate outside North Korea before travel through a DPRK mission or authorized tourism channel.
conditions: Applies to a Chinese private ordinary passport; diplomatic, service and public-affairs ordinary passports have a separate treaty route.
A DPRK visa must be handled before travel by a DPRK diplomatic or consular mission outside North Korea; an authorized travel agency handles the alternative tourism certificate.
A DPRK receiving organization or organized-tour channel is required, and in-country movement and registration are controlled.
Transit, border-area permits, other passport types and final admission remain outside this classification.

policies.title: U.S. ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visa
policies.summary: Current U.S. State Department guidance requires U.S. citizens to obtain an Afghan visa before travel and warns that the de facto authorities may reject visas from Republic-era missions they do not recognize.
conditions: Applies to a U.S. citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit; U.S. citizens treated as Afghan nationals or travelling on an Afghan passport follow separate rules.
The visa must be obtained before travel from a consular authority accepted by the Afghan de facto authorities; some Republic-era mission visas may be refused.
The passport must remain valid for at least six months beyond arrival and have a blank page.
Security advice, purpose restrictions, registration, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visa
policies.summary: Slovenia’s current government country page requires Slovenian citizens to obtain an Afghan visa and identifies the Afghan Embassy in Vienna as the application mission.
conditions: Applies to a Slovenian citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit.
The visa application is made before travel through the Afghan Embassy in Vienna.
Mission recognition, document validity, purpose restrictions, security conditions, carrier checks and final admission must be confirmed before travel.

policies.title: Chinese ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visa
policies.summary: China’s current consular guidance identifies an advance Afghan Embassy visa for Chinese ordinary-passport visitors and separately limits the bilateral waiver to diplomatic passports.
conditions: Applies to a Chinese citizen using an ordinary passport; the cited bilateral visa waiver is limited to diplomatic passports.

The Afghan Embassy in China normally issues a single-entry visa permitting a stay of up to 30 days after the applicant supplies the required passport, identity, application and Afghan invitation documents.
A visa marked AIR ONLY permits entry and exit only through airports under the 15 May 2025 rule.
Passport validity, purpose permissions, mission recognition, registration, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire visa exemption
policies.summary: SNEDAI’s live entry-visa exemption list directly names Singapore, Morocco, Tunisia, the Philippines, Chad, the Republic of the Congo and the Central African Republic and expressly includes ordinary passports. Their short-visitor baseline is visa-free, not an electronic or airport-issued visa.
conditions: The published list states the visa exemption but does not state a stay duration or a separate effective date.
Passport validity, health, security, entry-point and individual-admissibility controls remain separate from the visa exemption.
The list also covers official passports, but this policy normalizes only the ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline.
The live page embeds an asset uploaded in May 2024 and publishes no end date; recheck the active list when SNEDAI or the Ministry replaces it.

policies.title: Exact residual non-ECOWAS ordinary-passport cohort: Sierra Leone tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Sierra Leone's current official consular guidance makes a visa on arrival available to tourists and separately exempts ECOWAS visitors. The live National Tourist Board repeats that visitors do not need a pre-travel visa application, while the Finance Act defines the visa as issued at an airport or border crossing. Every passport in this exact residual is non-ECOWAS and therefore has the direct border-issued visitor route.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary passport with at least six months remaining for tourism or the stated potential-investor visitor purpose. The Embassy describes a stay not exceeding 30 days.

The Finance Act defines visa on arrival at an international airport or border crossing. The current Tourist Board says the policy operates for air, land and sea travel; port operation, carrier acceptance and individual admission still require current checks.
The Immigration Officer at the port of entry retains discretion to grant or deny admission. Health, security, accommodation, itinerary and sufficient-funds requirements remain separate.

ECOWAS ordinary passports are outside this policy and retain their separately documented visa-free treatment. Diplomatic, official and special documents, work, residence, study, transit and other purposes are not normalized here.

A separate electronic application is available for non-ECOWAS passports, but the official consular page independently permits direct visa-on-arrival access. The available border-issued route controls this single-status baseline.
Separately reviewed passport-specific statuses outside this exact residual cohort are not replaced by this policy; their more specific current evidence remains controlling.

The Embassy visa text has older page metadata but remains actively served within the current official 2026 site and is corroborated by the live 2026 Tourist Board visitor guidance; recheck if either authority publishes a replacement nationality schedule.

policies.title: Kosovo travel documents: Bosnia and Herzegovina advance visa on separate paper
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's current MFA guidance directly requires holders of Kosovo travel documents to obtain a visa and identifies the embassies that issue it on separate paper.
conditions: The visa is issued on separate paper by the Bosnia and Herzegovina embassies in Skopje, Podgorica or Belgrade and must be obtained before travel.
The result applies to an ordinary Kosovo travel document used for a short visitor journey; it does not imply diplomatic recognition or ordinary visa-sticker placement in the passport.
Transit, work, study, residence, diplomatic, official and other special-document treatment remain outside scope.
The MFA page is current and live, although its server currently presents an incomplete TLS certificate chain to some automated clients; recheck the consular route before travel.

policies.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis nationals: Kenya 90-day eTA exemption
policies.summary: Kenya's current legal eTA-exemption schedule places the uniquely identifiable Saint Kitts and Nevis nationality in its 90-day cohort, despite the recurring one-letter misspelling 'Navis'.
conditions: The exemption applies to nationals of Saint Kitts and Nevis for a stay not exceeding 90 days.

The official schedule says 'St. Kitts and Navis'. No country or passport issuer named Navis exists, and the uniquely identifying St. Kitts prefix makes this an unambiguous spelling error rather than a successor-state or document ambiguity.
The traveller is exempt from Kenya's eTA requirement; normal passport validity, purpose-of-stay and final-admission rules continue to apply.
Work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and other special-document treatment remain outside scope.

policies.title: DR Congo: Kenyan and Tanzanian citizens have EAC visa-free entry
policies.summary: The EAC's current immigration rule gives citizens of every Partner State visa-free entry into other Partner States, and its current overview names DR Congo, Kenya and Tanzania as members.
conditions: Applies to the ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline for Kenyan and Tanzanian citizens entering DR Congo under current EAC implementation.
The EAC page does not state a numeric stay limit. Required travel documents, border operations, immigration controls, public-health rules and final admission remain applicable.
A still-live FAQ written in 2016 predates DR Congo's 2022 accession and is not treated as a current exception to the later all-Partner-State rule.

policies.title: DR Congo: Mauritian passports require an advance visa
policies.summary: Mauritius's current official traveler table directly says Mauritian nationals need a visa before departure for DR Congo.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mauritian passport holder travelling to DR Congo for a short visit.
The schedule directs the traveler to the DR Congo embassy competent for Mauritius; this is pre-travel consular issuance, not an arrival-issued or electronic visa.
Passport validity, supporting documents, processing, carrier checks and final admission remain subject to the competent authorities.

policies.title: Jordan: four unrestricted nationalities may obtain a visa at the border
policies.summary: Jordan's current border guidance makes border visas available except to restricted nationalities, and the Interior Ministry's exhaustive restricted tables do not include Greece, Grenada, Palau or Timor-Leste.
conditions: Applies to ordinary passports used for short visitor travel. Each passport is outside Jordan's current restricted-nationality tables and therefore does not need prior approval.
The single-entry border visa costs 40 JOD. Passport validity of at least six months and final admission conditions remain applicable.
Use an eligible airport or crossing. Allenby/King Hussein Bridge and Wadi Araba do not issue the ordinary visa on arrival; crossing hours and rules can change.

policies.title: Algerian, Moroccan and Chadian ordinary passports: visa-free Mali visits
policies.summary: Mali MFA’s live assistant returns an explicit no-visa decision for the three valid nationality selections when the passport type is ordinary.
conditions: The valid nationality selections are exactly “Algérie”, “Maroc” and “Tchad”, with passport type set to “Ordinaire”.
Independent replays used France and Ghana as residence/competent-post inputs; each valid selection returned the same explicit no-visa result.
The portal publishes no short-visitor stay cap; work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, laissez-passer, special-document and final-admission rules are outside scope.
The selector is dynamic and mutable. Unknown nationality values default incorrectly to its no-visa alert: Cyprus is not listed, and invalid “Turquie”/“Turkey” must not be treated as Türkiye.
Recheck before use because the assistant has known conflicts with stronger regional and passport-government evidence for other nationalities.

policies.title: Ghanaian ordinary passports: São Tomé and Príncipe visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The live São Toméan SMF notice names Ghana for a cooperation-agreement visa exemption of up to 90 days, corroborated by Ghana MFA's current ordinary-passport 90-day waiver register.
conditions: Applies to Ghanaian ordinary passports for a short visitor stay of up to 90 days. The SMF notice states entry remains subject to a passport valid for at least three months, sufficient funds and return/onward evidence.
It does not establish work, residence, transit, diplomatic, service, official, crew or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Namibian ordinary passports: visa-free Angola visits
policies.summary: Namibia's current MHAISS fact sheet expressly says Namibians need no visa to visit Angola; Angola's bilateral register records the ordinary-passport exemption.
conditions: Valid ordinary Namibian passport; short visitor or tourism use only.
The current fact sheet states the exemption but does not publish a stay cap, port restriction or business-purpose rule; those matters require recheck before travel.
This bilateral exemption is independent of, and is not displaced by, the 98-country Decree 189/23 tourism-waiver regime.

Source replay risk: the main MHAISS PDF timed out and its alternate e-services URL failed TLS validation during the 25 August 2026 recheck; Angola's corroborating register has 2020 embedded metadata and a 2025 HTTP timestamp.
